# Phenotypic characterization
```{r, error=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

# Rename columns
phenotype <- phenotype %>%
  rename(
    Age = Age_yr,
    BMI = BMI_kgm2,
    Menopause = Menopause_YN,
    Glucose = Glucose_mgdL,
    HbA1c = HbA1c_percent,
    AST = AST_UL,
```

### Read Input Data and Subsetting Based on Gender for Downstream Analysis
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE}
# Load description data
description <- data.frame(readxl::read_excel("/Users/skga/Desktop/Gothenburg_project/Analyisis/description.xlsx"))
rownames(description) <- description$Exposure
description <- description[, -2]

# Load exposures data
exposures <- data.frame(readxl::read_excel("/Users/skga/Desktop/Gothenburg_project/Analyisis/exposures.xlsx"))
rownames(exposures) <- exposures$id
exposures <- exposures[, -1]

# Replace zeros with NA
exposures[exposures == 0] <- NA

# Align exposures with phenotypic data
common_rows <- intersect(rownames(exposures), rownames(phenotype))
exposures_reordered <- exposures[rownames(phenotype), , drop = FALSE]
exposures <- exposures_reordered

# Validate alignment
table(row.names(exposures) == row.names(phenotype))

# Modify description data for better labeling
description$ID <- paste0(description$Family, "_", row.names(description))
description$ID <- gsub("rowid_", "", description$ID)
description$ID <- gsub(" ", "_", description$ID)

# Update row names for exposures
exposures <- t(exposures)
new_row_names <- description$ID[match(rownames(exposures), rownames(description))]
rownames(exposures) <- new_row_names
exposures <- t(exposures)
lipidomics_exposures <- exposures
# Clean phenotype data
df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(phenotype, "SampleID")
min_value_GGT_UL <- min(df$GGT_UL, na.rm = TRUE)
df$GGT_UL[is.na(df$GGT_UL)] <- min_value_GGT_UL / 2
# min_value_Menopause_YN <- min(df$Menopause_YN, na.rm = TRUE)
# df$Menopause_YN[is.na(df$Menopause_YN)] <- min_value_Menopause_YN / 2
df$Menopause_YN <- NULL
```

### Data Normalization and Visualization
```{r, fig.align='center', fig.height=8, fig.width=12}
# Create a POMA object
data <- POMA::PomaCreateObject(metadata = df, features = exposures)
# Impute missing data using half-minimum method
imputed <- data %>%
  PomaImpute(method = "half_min", zeros_as_na = TRUE, remove_na = TRUE, cutoff = 20)

log2_transformed <- imputed %>%
    PomaNorm(method = "log_transform")

# Normalize the data using log scaling
normalized <- log2_transformed %>% 
  PomaNorm(method = "auto_scaling")

# Create boxplots for visualization before and after normalization
a <- PomaBoxplots(imputed, x = "samples") +
     ggplot2::ggtitle("Not Normalized") + 
     ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank())

b <- PomaBoxplots(log2_transformed, x = "samples") +
     ggplot2::ggtitle("Log transformed") + 
     ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank())

c <- PomaBoxplots(normalized, x = "samples") +
    ggplot2::ggtitle("Auto scaling") +
    ggplot2::theme(axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_blank())

# Combine the plots for comparison
#a + b + c

b + c
```


```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}

exposures_Normalized = as.data.frame(normalized@assays@data@listData)

lipidomics_data <- exposures_Normalized
exposures_Normalized <- t(exposures_Normalized)
dim(exposures_Normalized) %>% paste(c("Samples", "Metabolites"))

# Determine soft threshold using WGCNA's pickSoftThreshold function
powers <- c(1:10, seq(12,30,2))
sft <- pickSoftThreshold(exposures_Normalized, 
                         powerVector = powers, 
                         verbose = 1, 
                         networkType = "signed",
                         corFn = "bicor")

# Identify the appropriate soft thresholding power (st)
idx <- min(which((-sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2]) > 0.90))
if (is.infinite(idx)) {
  idx <- min(which((-sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2]) > 0.80))
  if (!is.infinite(idx)) {
    st <- sft$fitIndices[idx,1]
  } else {
    idx <- which.max(-sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2])
    st <- sft$fitIndices[idx,1]
  }
} else {
  st <- sft$fitIndices[idx,1]
}

# Plot scale independence vs. soft thresholding power
data.frame(Indices = sft$fitIndices[,1],
           sfApprox = -sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2]) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.9, color = "red", alpha = 0.6) +  # R^2 cut-off of 0.9
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, color = "red", alpha = 0.2) +  # R^2 cut-off of 0.8
  geom_line(aes(x = Indices, y = sfApprox), color = "red", alpha = 0.1, size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(mapping = aes(x = Indices, y = sfApprox, label = Indices), color = "red", size = 4) +
  ggtitle("Scale Independence") +
  xlab("Soft Threshold (power)") +
  ylab("SF Model Fit, signed R^2") +
  xlim(1, 30) + 
  theme_bw() +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = st, y = 0.25, xend = st, yend = sfApprox[idx] - 0.05),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               size = 0.5) -> scale_independence_plot

# Plot mean connectivity vs. soft thresholding power
data.frame(Indices = sft$fitIndices[,1],
           meanApprox = sft$fitIndices[,5]) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(x = Indices, y = meanApprox), color = "red", alpha = 0.1, size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(mapping = aes(x = Indices, y = meanApprox, label = Indices), color = "red", size = 4) +
  xlab("Soft Threshold (power)") +
  ylab("Mean Connectivity") +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_segment(aes(x = st - 0.4, 
                   y = sft$fitIndices$mean.k.[idx], 
                   xend = 0, 
                   yend = sft$fitIndices$mean.k.[idx]),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               size = 0.4) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Mean Connectivity: ", round(sft$fitIndices$mean.k.[idx], 2))) -> mean_connectivity_plot

# Set label size for plot grid
plot_labeling_size <- 15

```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
# Perform WGCNA on the adjusted data
modules.omics <- blockwiseModules(exposures_Normalized,
                                  power = 12, 
                                  networkType = "signed", 
                                  TOMType = "signed",
                                  corType = "bicor",
                                  deepSplit = 4, 
                                  minModuleSize = 20,  
                                  numericLabels = TRUE,
                                  saveTOMs = FALSE,
                                  saveTOMFileBase = "TOM",
                                  verbose = 1,
                                  maxBlockSize = 8000,
                                  mergeCutHeight = 0.1,
                                  nThreads = 6)

# Identify top hubs in each module
hubs_M <- chooseTopHubInEachModule(exposures_Normalized, modules.omics$colors, power = st, omitColors = "0")


# Store WGCNA analysis results with covariate adjustment
stage2results_lipids <- list(modules = modules.omics, hubs = hubs_M)

stage2results_lipids$hubs %>% 
    as.data.frame() %>% 
    dplyr::rename("gene_id" = ".") %>% 
    tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "Module") -> top_genes

DT::datatable(top_genes)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, results='hide', fig.align='center', fig.keep='none'}
# Prepare data for module colors and dendrogram plotting

res <- res[, c(1,3,2)]

# Plot dendrogram and module colors for each block
for(i in seq_along(stage2results_lipids$modules$dendrograms)){

                      main = paste0("Cluster Dendrogram\n", 
                                    "for Block ", 
                                    i, ": ",
                                    length(stage2results_lipids$modules$blockGenes[[i]]),
                                    " Metabolites"))
}

# Calculate pairwise module eigengene (ME) correlations
MEs <- stage2results_lipids$modules$MEs
prefix <- "Lipids"
MEs_R <- bicor(MEs, MEs, maxPOutliers = 0.05)

# Remove ME0 from correlation matrix for visualization
idx.r <- which(rownames(MEs_R) == "ME0")
idx.c <- which(colnames(MEs_R) == "ME0")
MEs_R_noME0 <- MEs_R[-idx.r, -idx.c]

# Plot histogram of ME correlations excluding ME0
MEs_R_noME0[upper.tri(MEs_R_noME0)] %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  dplyr::rename("Correlation" = ".") %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x = Correlation)) + 
  geom_histogram(bins = 20) +

  xlim(-1, 1) +
  ggtitle(paste0("ME Correlation\n without ", "ME0")) -> MEs_R_density

# Generate heatmap of ME correlations excluding ME0
pheatmap::pheatmap(MEs_R_noME0, color = colorRampPalette(c("Blue", "White", "Red"))(100),
                   silent = FALSE, 
                   breaks = seq(-1, 1, length.out = 101),
                   treeheight_row = 5, 
                   treeheight_col = 5,
                   main = paste0("ME Correlation Heatmap without ", prefix, " ME0"),

# Check alignment between exposures and MEs
all(rownames(exposures_Normalized) == rownames(MEs))
dim(exposures_Normalized) %>% paste0(c("Samples", "Metabolites"))

# Calculate module-trait relationships (kME)

dim(kME) %>% paste0(c("Metabolites", "Modules"))

# Calculate intra-module correlations
intra_cor <- c()
for (i in 1:ncol(exposures_Normalized)) {
  m <- stage2results_lipids$modules$colors[i]

  } else {
    intra_cor[i] <- NA
  }
}

idx <- which(is.na(intra_cor))
intra_cor <- intra_cor[-idx]

plot(density(intra_cor), main = "Correlations with Module-Eigen Metabolites in Female Samples (Within-Module Correlation)\nNo ME0", xlim = c(-1, 1))
```

```{r , fig.align='center', fig.height=14, fig.width=12}
# Function to calculate within-module correlations
corr_within_module <- function(exposures_Normalized, modules, module_x = 1){
  idx.exposures_Normalized <- which(modules$colors == module_x)
  idx.me <- which(colnames(modules$MEs) == paste0("ME", module_x))
  kME_x <- bicor(exposures_Normalized[, idx.exposures_Normalized], modules$MEs[, idx.me], maxPOutliers = 0.05)
  kME_x
}

# Generate density plots for all modules
ggplot.list <- list()

for(m in colnames(stage2results_lipids$modules$MEs)){
  h <- as.numeric(sub("ME", "", m))
  data.frame(x = suppressWarnings(corr_within_module(exposures_Normalized = exposures_Normalized, modules = stage2results_lipids$modules, module_x = h))) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    geom_histogram(aes(x), fill = labels2colors(h), color = "black", alpha = 0.5, bins = 20) + 
    xlim(-1, 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    xlab("Metabolite Correlation") +
    ggtitle(paste0(prefix, "_", m)) -> da_plot
  
  ggplot.list[[m]] <- da_plot
}

ggplot.list <- ggplot.list[ggplot.list %>% names() %>% sub("ME", "", .) %>% as.numeric() %>% order()]

# Combine density plots for all modules into a grid
cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = ggplot.list, ncol = 6) -> density_all_plot

# Combine all parts into one final plot grid
cowplot::plot_grid(si_mc_plot, density_eigen, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.8, 1)) -> part_1
cowplot::plot_grid(part_1, module_size_barplot, labels = c("", "C"), label_size = plot_labeling_size, rel_widths = c(1, 0.5)) -> part_2
cowplot::plot_grid(part_2, density_all_plot, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.8, 1), labels = c("", "F"), label_size = plot_labeling_size)
```

### Module-trait relationship
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=14, fig.height=9}
# Define numbers of genes and samples
nGenes = ncol(exposures_Normalized);
nSamples = nrow(exposures_Normalized);
moduleLabels = stage2results_lipids$modules$colors

# Recalculate MEs with color labels
MEs0 = moduleEigengenes(exposures_Normalized, moduleLabels)$eigengenes
MEs0$ME0 <- NULL
MEs = orderMEs(MEs0)
lipidomics_MEs <- MEs
#phenotype_Female$Menopause_YN <- NULL
df <- phenotype
# Convert Gender_M0F1 to 1 for Female and 0 for Male
df$Gender_M0F1 <- ifelse(df$Gender_M0F1 == "Male", 0, 1)
df$Steatosis <- ifelse(df$steatosis_Kleiner == 0, 0, 1)
df$Inflammation <- ifelse(df$inflammation_Kleiner == 0, 0, 1)
df$Fibrosis <- ifelse(df$fibrosis_Kleiner_04 == 0, 0, 1)


df$steatosis_Kleiner <- NULL
df$inflammation_Kleiner <- NULL
df$ballooning_Kleiner <- NULL
df$NASH_Kleiner_YN <- NULL
df$fibrosis_Kleiner_04 <- NULL
df$NAS_score <- NULL
df$Menopause_YN <- NULL


df <- df %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Age = Age_yr,
    Gender = Gender_M0F1,
    BMI = BMI_kgm2,
    Glucose = Glucose_mgdL,
    HbA1c = HbA1c_percent,
    AST = AST_UL,
    ALT = ALT_UL,
    GGT = GGT_UL,
    Cholesterol = Cholesterol_mgdL,
    HDL = HDL_mgdL,
    LDL = LDL_mgdL,
    Triglycerides = TG_mgdL,
    Steatosis = Steatosis,
    Inflammation = Inflammation,
    Fibrosis = Fibrosis
  )


#phenotype$Gender_M0F1 <- NULL
moduleTraitCor = cor(MEs, df, use = "p");
moduleTraitPvalue = corPvalueStudent(moduleTraitCor, nSamples);

# Will display correlations and their p-values
textMatrix =  paste(signif(moduleTraitCor, 2), "\n(",
                           signif(moduleTraitPvalue, 1), ")", sep = "");
dim(textMatrix) = dim(moduleTraitCor)
heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 6, name ="RdBu")))(51)
par(mar = c(12, 4, 2, 2) + 0.1)  # c(bottom, left, top, right)
# Display the correlation values within a heatmap plot
labeledHeatmap(Matrix = moduleTraitCor,
               xLabels = names(df),
               yLabels = names(MEs),
               ySymbols = names(MEs),
               colorLabels = FALSE,
               colors = heatmap_colors,
               textMatrix = textMatrix,
               setStdMargins = FALSE,
               cex.text = 0.5,
               zlim = c(-1,1),
               cluster_rows = T,
               main = paste("Module-trait relationships"))
```

Creates above heatmap with stars
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=14, fig.height=9}
# Calculate correlations and p-values
moduleTraitCor = cor(MEs, df, use = "p")
moduleTraitPvalue = corPvalueStudent(moduleTraitCor, nSamples)

# Initialize a matrix to store the significance levels
signif_matrix <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(moduleTraitCor), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitCor))
three_star <- which(moduleTraitPvalue <= 0.001, arr.ind = TRUE)
two_star <- which((moduleTraitPvalue <= 0.01) & (moduleTraitPvalue > 0.001), arr.ind = TRUE)
one_star <- which((moduleTraitPvalue <= 0.05) & (moduleTraitPvalue > 0.01), arr.ind = TRUE)
signif_matrix[three_star] <- "***"
signif_matrix[two_star] <- "**"
signif_matrix[one_star] <- "*"

# Combine the correlation values with significance levels
textMatrix = matrix(paste(signif_matrix), 
                    nrow = nrow(moduleTraitCor), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitCor))

# Set heatmap colors
heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 6, name = "RdBu")))(51)
X_ME_dendro <- hclust(as.dist(1 - WGCNA::bicor(MEs, maxPOutliers = 0.05)), method = "ward.D2")
# Plot the heatmap with pheatmap
pheatmap::pheatmap(
  mat = moduleTraitCor,
  color = heatmap_colors,
  display_numbers = textMatrix,
  number_color = "black",
 cluster_rows = F,
  cluster_cols = F,

  fontsize_number = 8,  # Adjust font size of the numbers
  breaks = seq(from = -1, to = 1, length.out = 51), 
  treeheight_row = 0,
  treeheight_col = 0
)
```

#### With FDR (BH p-value <0.1)
```{r}
plot_module_trait_correlation <- function(MEs, df_subset, plot_title = "Module-Trait Relationships") {
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  
  nSamples <- nrow(df_subset)
  
  # Correlation matrix
  moduleTraitCor <- cor(MEs[rownames(df_subset), ], df_subset, use = "p")
  moduleTraitPvalue <- corPvalueStudent(moduleTraitCor, nSamples)
  
  # FDR correction
  pval_adjusted <- p.adjust(as.vector(moduleTraitPvalue), method = "fdr")
  fdr_matrix <- matrix(pval_adjusted, nrow = nrow(moduleTraitPvalue), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitPvalue))
  
  # Create significance stars
  signif_matrix <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(moduleTraitCor), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitCor))
  signif_matrix[fdr_matrix <= 0.001] <- "***"
  signif_matrix[fdr_matrix > 0.001 & fdr_matrix <= 0.01] <- "**"
  signif_matrix[fdr_matrix > 0.01 & fdr_matrix <= 0.1] <- "*"
  
  # Transpose for heatmap orientation
  moduleTraitCor <- t(moduleTraitCor)
  signif_matrix <- t(signif_matrix)
  
  # Custom blue-red diverging palette
  custom_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#4575B4", "white", "#ffa500ff"))(51)
  range_limit <- 0.6
  breaks <- seq(from = -range_limit, to = range_limit, length.out = 51)
  
  # Plot heatmap
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat = moduleTraitCor,
    color = custom_colors,
    display_numbers = signif_matrix,
    number_color = "black",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    main = plot_title,
    fontsize_number = 8,
    breaks = breaks,
    treeheight_row = 0,
    treeheight_col = 0
  )
}
plot_module_trait_correlation(MEs, df_male, "Lipidomics - Men")
plot_module_trait_correlation(MEs, df_female, "Lipidomics - Women")
```

### Table
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(DT)

# Classify metabolite names as identified / putative / unknown
classify_metabolite <- function(name) {
  name <- tolower(name)
  if (str_detect(name, "unknown")) {
    return("unknown")
  } else if (str_detect(name, "putative|likely|predicted")) {
    return("putative")
  } else {
    return("identified")
  }
}

# Apply classification to each metabolite
gene_module_key_classified <- gene_module_key %>%
  mutate(class = sapply(Metabolites, classify_metabolite))

# Extract hub metabolite per module and rename appropriately
top_genes <- stage2results_lipids$hubs %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename("Hub name" = ".") %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "module") %>%
  mutate(module = paste0("ME", module))  # Ensure format matches 'gene_module_key'

# Create final summary table
summary_table <- gene_module_key_classified %>%
  group_by(module) %>%
  summarise(
    `Cluster number` = unique(module),
    `N (identified)` = sum(class == "identified"),
    `N (unknown)` = sum(class == "unknown"),
    `N (total)` = n(),
    `Content summary` = paste(head(Metabolites, 3), collapse = ", ")
  ) %>%
  left_join(top_genes, by = "module") %>%
  dplyr::select(
    `Cluster number`,
    `N (identified)`,
    `N (unknown)`,
    `N (total)`,
    `Hub name`,
    `Content summary`
  ) %>%
  arrange(`Cluster number`)


# Ensure description$ID is uppercase to match metabolite names in Content summary
description <- description %>%
  mutate(ID_upper = toupper(ID))

# Step 2: Create lookup named vector
id_to_name <- setNames(description$Name, description$ID_upper)

# Step 3: Function to replace metabolite IDs in `Content summary`
replace_with_name <- function(summary_str, id_map) {
  items <- strsplit(summary_str, ",\\s*")[[1]]
  replaced <- sapply(items, function(x) {
    lookup <- id_map[[toupper(x)]]
    if (!is.null(lookup)) lookup else x
  })
  paste(replaced, collapse = ", ")
}

# Step 4: Apply replacement to both `Content summary` and `Hub name`
summary_table <- summary_table %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    `Content summary` = replace_with_name(`Content summary`, id_to_name),
    `Hub name` = {
      hub_upper <- toupper(`Hub name`)
      matched_name <- id_to_name[hub_upper]
      if (!is.na(matched_name)) matched_name else `Hub name`
    }
  ) %>%
  ungroup()


# Step 5: View updated table
DT::datatable(summary_table)
WriteXLS::WriteXLS(summary_table, "lipid_modules_details.xlsx")
```

### Linear model: Individual omics 
```{r, warning=FALSE, error=FALSE}
set.seed(12345)
# Male Data Analysis
exposures_Normalized = as.data.frame(normalized@assays@data@listData)

# Ensure sample IDs match between exposures and phenotype data
common_samples <- intersect(colnames(exposures_Normalized), rownames(df))

# Subset data to include only common samples
metabolites <- exposures_Normalized[, common_samples]
df <- df[common_samples, ]

# Initialize results storage
results_male <- data.frame(Metabolite = rownames(metabolites), 
                            Estimate = NA, 
                            StdError = NA, 
                            PValue = NA)

# Perform logistic regression for each metabolite
for (i in 1:nrow(metabolites)) {
    metabolite_values <- as.numeric(metabolites[i, ])
    
    model <- glm(df$Fibrosis ~ metabolite_values +  df$Age + df$BMI + df$Gender,
                 family = binomial(link = "logit"))
    
    summary_model <- summary(model)
    results_male$Estimate[i] <- summary_model$coefficients[2, 1]
    results_male$StdError[i] <- summary_model$coefficients[2, 2]
    results_male$PValue[i] <- summary_model$coefficients[2, 4]
}

# Adjust p-values using FDR correction
results_male$FDR_PValue <- p.adjust(results_male$PValue, method = "fdr")

# Identify significantly upregulated and downregulated metabolites
upregulated_male <- results_male %>% filter(Estimate > 0 & PValue < 0.05)
downregulated_male <- results_male %>% filter(Estimate < 0 & PValue < 0.05)

# Print summary
cat("Number of upregulated metabolites in males:", nrow(upregulated_male), "\n")
cat("Number of downregulated metabolites in males:", nrow(downregulated_male), "\n")




# Identify significantly upregulated and downregulated metabolites
upregulated_male <- results_male %>% filter(Estimate > 0 & FDR_PValue < 0.1)
downregulated_male <- results_male %>% filter(Estimate < 0 & FDR_PValue < 0.1)

# Print summary
cat("Number of upregulated metabolites in males:", nrow(upregulated_male), "\n")
cat("Number of downregulated metabolites in males:", nrow(downregulated_male), "\n")





# View significant results
DT::datatable(upregulated_male)
DT::datatable(downregulated_male)
```

### DEGs Lipids
```{r}
library(limma)

# Transpose matrix: rows = metabolites, columns = samples
metabo_mat <- (as.matrix(exposures_Normalized))

# Check dimensions
dim(metabo_mat)
# Should be: features x samples, e.g., 701 x 189

# Ensure column names match metadata rownames
all(colnames(metabo_mat) == (df$SampleID))  # should be TRUE

# Phenotype metadata
metadata <- df
metadata$Steatosis <- factor(metadata$Steatosis, levels = c(0,1))
metadata$Inflammation <- factor(metadata$Inflammation, levels = c(0,1))
metadata$Fibrosis <- factor(metadata$Fibrosis, levels = c(0,1))
metadata$Gender <- factor(metadata$Gender, levels = c(0,1))  # 0 = Male, 1 = Female

# Differential analysis function
run_diff <- function(phenotype){
  design <- model.matrix(~ Age + BMI + Gender + metadata[[phenotype]], data = metadata)
  
  fit <- lmFit(metabo_mat, design)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)
  
  # Coefficient of interest = last column (phenotype effect)
  coef_name <- ncol(design)
  res <- topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  return(res)
}

# Run for each phenotype
res_steatosis <- run_diff("Steatosis")
res_inflammation <- run_diff("Inflammation")
res_fibrosis <- run_diff("Fibrosis")

# Filter significant metabolites (FDR < 0.1)
sig_steatosis <- res_steatosis[res_steatosis$adj.P.Val < 0.1, ]
sig_inflammation <- res_inflammation[res_inflammation$adj.P.Val < 0.1, ]
sig_fibrosis <- res_fibrosis[res_fibrosis$adj.P.Val < 0.1, ]

library(dplyr)

# Add phenotype and direction columns for each condition
sig_steatosis_tbl <- sig_steatosis %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = "Steatosis",
         Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
         Metabolite = rownames(sig_steatosis)) %>%
  select(Metabolite, Phenotype, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction)

sig_inflammation_tbl <- sig_inflammation %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = "Inflammation",
         Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
         Metabolite = rownames(sig_inflammation)) %>%
  select(Metabolite, Phenotype, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction)

sig_fibrosis_tbl <- sig_fibrosis %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = "Fibrosis",
         Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
         Metabolite = rownames(sig_fibrosis)) %>%
  select(Metabolite, Phenotype, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction)

# Combine all into a single table
combined_sig_tbl <- bind_rows(sig_steatosis_tbl, sig_inflammation_tbl, sig_fibrosis_tbl)

# Optional: sort by Phenotype and logFC
combined_sig_tbl <- combined_sig_tbl %>%
  arrange(Phenotype, desc(logFC))

# View table
write.csv(combined_sig_tbl, "Supplementary_Table_Significant_LIPIDS.csv", row.names = FALSE)

```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
exposures_Normalized <- as.data.frame(normalized@assays@data@listData)

exposures_Normalized <- t(exposures_Normalized)
dim(exposures_Normalized) %>% paste(c("Samples", "Metabolites"))
# Determine soft threshold using WGCNA's pickSoftThreshold function
powers <- c(1:10, seq(12,30,2))
sft <- pickSoftThreshold(exposures_Normalized, 
                         powerVector = powers, 
                         verbose = 1, 
                         networkType = "signed",
                         corFn = "bicor")

# Identify the appropriate soft thresholding power (st)
idx <- min(which((-sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2]) > 0.90))
if (is.infinite(idx)) {
  idx <- min(which((-sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2]) > 0.80))
  if (!is.infinite(idx)) {
    st <- sft$fitIndices[idx,1]
  } else {
    idx <- which.max(-sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2])
    st <- sft$fitIndices[idx,1]
  }
} else {
  st <- sft$fitIndices[idx,1]
}

# Plot scale independence vs. soft thresholding power
data.frame(Indices = sft$fitIndices[,1],
           sfApprox = -sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2]) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.9, color = "red", alpha = 0.6) +  # R^2 cut-off of 0.9
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, color = "red", alpha = 0.2) +  # R^2 cut-off of 0.8
  geom_line(aes(x = Indices, y = sfApprox), color = "red", alpha = 0.1, size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(mapping = aes(x = Indices, y = sfApprox, label = Indices), color = "red", size = 4) +
  ggtitle("Scale Independence") +
  xlab("Soft Threshold (power)") +
  ylab("SF Model Fit, signed R^2") +
  xlim(1, 30) + 
  theme_bw() +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = st, y = 0.25, xend = st, yend = sfApprox[idx] - 0.05),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               size = 0.5) -> scale_independence_plot

# Plot mean connectivity vs. soft thresholding power
data.frame(Indices = sft$fitIndices[,1],
           meanApprox = sft$fitIndices[,5]) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(x = Indices, y = meanApprox), color = "red", alpha = 0.1, size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(mapping = aes(x = Indices, y = meanApprox, label = Indices), color = "red", size = 4) +
  xlab("Soft Threshold (power)") +
  ylab("Mean Connectivity") +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_segment(aes(x = st - 0.4, 
                   y = sft$fitIndices$mean.k.[idx], 
                   xend = 0, 
                   yend = sft$fitIndices$mean.k.[idx]),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               size = 0.4) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Mean Connectivity: ", round(sft$fitIndices$mean.k.[idx], 2))) -> mean_connectivity_plot

# Set label size for plot grid
plot_labeling_size <- 15

```

```{r}
# Define a function for correlation and rotated heatmap plotting
plot_module_trait_correlation <- function(MEs, df_subset, gender_label) {
  nSamples <- nrow(df_subset)
  
  # Correlation and p-values
  moduleTraitCor <- cor(MEs[rownames(df_subset), ], df_subset, use = "p", method = "spearman")
  moduleTraitPvalue <- corPvalueStudent(moduleTraitCor, nSamples)
  
  # Significance stars
  signif_matrix <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(moduleTraitCor), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitCor))
  signif_matrix[moduleTraitPvalue <= 0.001] <- "***"
  signif_matrix[moduleTraitPvalue > 0.001 & moduleTraitPvalue <= 0.01] <- "**"
  signif_matrix[moduleTraitPvalue > 0.01 & moduleTraitPvalue <= 0.05] <- "*"
  
  # Combine as annotation matrix
  textMatrix <- matrix(paste(signif_matrix), 
                       nrow = nrow(moduleTraitCor), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitCor))
  
  # Transpose correlation and annotation matrices
  moduleTraitCor_t <- t(moduleTraitCor)
  textMatrix_t <- t(textMatrix)
  


  # Plot heatmap (rotated)
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat = moduleTraitCor_t,
     color = colorRampPalette(c("#4575B4", "white", "#ffa500ff"))(51), 
    display_numbers = textMatrix_t,
    number_color = "black",

    fontsize_number = 8,
    breaks = seq(from = -1, to = 1, length.out = 51),
    treeheight_row = 0,
    treeheight_col = 0
  )
}
```

#### with FDR (BH, p-value <0.1)

```{r}
plot_module_trait_correlation <- function(MEs, df_subset, plot_title = "Module-Trait Relationships") {
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  
  nSamples <- nrow(df_subset)
  
  # Correlation matrix
  moduleTraitCor <- cor(MEs[rownames(df_subset), ], df_subset, use = "p", method = "spearman")
  moduleTraitPvalue <- corPvalueStudent(moduleTraitCor, nSamples)
  
  # FDR correction
  pval_adjusted <- p.adjust(as.vector(moduleTraitPvalue), method = "fdr")
  fdr_matrix <- matrix(pval_adjusted, nrow = nrow(moduleTraitPvalue), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitPvalue))
  
  # Create significance stars
  signif_matrix <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(moduleTraitCor), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitCor))
  signif_matrix[fdr_matrix <= 0.001] <- "***"
  signif_matrix[fdr_matrix > 0.001 & fdr_matrix <= 0.01] <- "**"
  signif_matrix[fdr_matrix > 0.01 & fdr_matrix <= 0.1] <- "*"
  
  # Transpose for heatmap orientation
  moduleTraitCor <- t(moduleTraitCor)
  signif_matrix <- t(signif_matrix)
  
  # Heatmap color settings
  heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#4575B4", "white", "#ffa500ff"))(51)
  range_limit <- 0.6
  breaks <- seq(from = -range_limit, to = range_limit, length.out = 51)
  
  # Plot heatmap
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat = moduleTraitCor,
    color = heatmap_colors,
    display_numbers = signif_matrix,
    number_color = "black",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    main = plot_title,
    fontsize_number = 8,
    breaks = breaks,
    treeheight_row = 0,
    treeheight_col = 0, 
    legend_labels = F, 
    legend = F, 
    show_rownames = F
  )
}


# Call the function for male and female data
plot_metabolomcis <- plot_module_trait_correlation(MEs, df, "Polar-Semipolars")
plot_module_trait_correlation(MEs, df_male, "Polar-Semipolars")
plot_module_trait_correlation(MEs, df_female, "Polar-Semipolars")
```

### Table
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(DT)

# Classify metabolite names as identified / putative / unknown
classify_metabolite <- function(name) {
  name <- tolower(name)
  if (str_detect(name, "unknown")) {
    return("unknown")
  } else if (str_detect(name, "putative|likely|predicted")) {
    return("putative")
  } else {
    return("identified")
  }
}

# Apply classification to each metabolite
gene_module_key_classified <- polar_semipolar_metabolites_module_key %>%
  mutate(class = sapply(Metabolites, classify_metabolite))

# Extract hub metabolite per module and rename appropriately
top_genes <- stage2results_Semipolar$hubs %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename("Hub name" = ".") %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "module") %>%
  mutate(module = paste0("ME", module))  # Ensure format matches 'gene_module_key'

# Create final summary table with improved content summary
summary_table <- gene_module_key_classified %>%
  group_by(module) %>%
  summarise(
    Cluster_number = unique(module),
    N_identified = sum(class == "identified"),
    N_putative = sum(class == "putative"),
    N_unknown = sum(class == "unknown"),
    N_total = n(),
    Content_summary = {
      # Extract metabolite names per class
      identified_names <- Metabolites[class == "identified"]
      putative_names <- Metabolites[class == "putative"]
      unknown_names <- Metabolites[class == "unknown"]
      
      # Collapse into a single string
      summary_list <- c(identified_names, putative_names)
      if (length(unknown_names) > 0) {
        summary_list <- c(summary_list, unknown_names[1])  # Add only one 'unknown'
      }
      paste(summary_list, collapse = ", ")
    }
  ) %>%
  left_join(top_genes, by = c("module")) %>%
  dplyr::select(
    Cluster_number,
    N_identified,
    N_putative,
    N_unknown,
    N_total,
    `Hub name`,
    Content_summary
  ) %>%
  arrange(Cluster_number)



# Step 5: View updated table
DT::datatable(summary_table)
WriteXLS::WriteXLS(summary_table, "Metabolomics_cluster_summary.xlsx")
```

### DEGs Metabolomics
```{r}
library(limma)

# Transpose matrix: rows = metabolites, columns = samples
metabo_mat <- t(as.matrix(exposures_Normalized))

# Check dimensions
dim(metabo_mat)
# Should be: features x samples, e.g., 701 x 189

# Ensure column names match metadata rownames
all(colnames(metabo_mat) == rownames(df))  # should be TRUE

# Phenotype metadata
metadata <- df
metadata$Steatosis <- factor(metadata$Steatosis, levels = c(0,1))
metadata$Inflammation <- factor(metadata$Inflammation, levels = c(0,1))
metadata$Fibrosis <- factor(metadata$Fibrosis, levels = c(0,1))
metadata$Gender <- factor(metadata$Gender, levels = c(0,1))  # 0 = Male, 1 = Female

# Differential analysis function
run_diff <- function(phenotype){
  design <- model.matrix(~ Age + BMI + Gender + metadata[[phenotype]], data = metadata)
  
  fit <- lmFit(metabo_mat, design)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)
  
  # Coefficient of interest = last column (phenotype effect)
  coef_name <- ncol(design)
  res <- topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  return(res)
}

# Run for each phenotype
res_steatosis <- run_diff("Steatosis")
res_inflammation <- run_diff("Inflammation")
res_fibrosis <- run_diff("Fibrosis")

# Filter significant metabolites (FDR < 0.1)
sig_steatosis <- res_steatosis[res_steatosis$adj.P.Val < 0.1, ]
sig_inflammation <- res_inflammation[res_inflammation$adj.P.Val < 0.1, ]
sig_fibrosis <- res_fibrosis[res_fibrosis$adj.P.Val < 0.1, ]

library(dplyr)

# Add phenotype and direction columns for each condition
sig_steatosis_tbl <- sig_steatosis %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = "Steatosis",
         Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
         Metabolite = rownames(sig_steatosis)) %>%
  select(Metabolite, Phenotype, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction)

sig_inflammation_tbl <- sig_inflammation %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = "Inflammation",
         Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
         Metabolite = rownames(sig_inflammation)) %>%
  select(Metabolite, Phenotype, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction)

sig_fibrosis_tbl <- sig_fibrosis %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = "Fibrosis",
         Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
         Metabolite = rownames(sig_fibrosis)) %>%
  select(Metabolite, Phenotype, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction)

# Combine all into a single table
combined_sig_tbl_biospy <- bind_rows(sig_steatosis_tbl, sig_inflammation_tbl)

# Optional: sort by Phenotype and logFC
combined_sig_tbl_biospy <- combined_sig_tbl_biospy %>%
  arrange(Phenotype, desc(logFC))
combined_sig_tbl_biospy$Tissue <- "Biopsy"
# View table
write.csv(combined_sig_tbl_biospy, "Supplementary_Table_Significant_Metabolites.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
# Transpose normalized data for subsequent analysis
exposures_Normalized <- t(assay(vst(dds)))
transcriptomics_data <- t(assay(vst(dds)))
dim(exposures_Normalized) %>% paste(c("Samples", "Genes"))

# Determine soft threshold using WGCNA's pickSoftThreshold function
powers <- c(1:10, seq(12,30,2))
sft <- pickSoftThreshold(exposures_Normalized, 
                         powerVector = powers, 
                         verbose = 1, 
                         networkType = "signed",
                         corFn = "bicor")

# Identify the appropriate soft thresholding power (st)
idx <- min(which((-sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2]) > 0.90))
if (is.infinite(idx)) {
  idx <- min(which((-sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2]) > 0.80))
  if (!is.infinite(idx)) {
    st <- sft$fitIndices[idx,1]
  } else {
    idx <- which.max(-sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2])
    st <- sft$fitIndices[idx,1]
  }
} else {
  st <- sft$fitIndices[idx,1]
}

# Plot scale independence vs. soft thresholding power
data.frame(Indices = sft$fitIndices[,1],
           sfApprox = -sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2]) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.9, color = "red", alpha = 0.6) +  # R^2 cut-off of 0.9
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, color = "red", alpha = 0.2) +  # R^2 cut-off of 0.8
  geom_line(aes(x = Indices, y = sfApprox), color = "red", alpha = 0.1, size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(mapping = aes(x = Indices, y = sfApprox, label = Indices), color = "red", size = 4) +
  ggtitle("Scale Independence") +
  xlab("Soft Threshold (power)") +
  ylab("SF Model Fit, signed R^2") +
  xlim(1, 30) + 
  theme_bw() +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = st, y = 0.25, xend = st, yend = sfApprox[idx] - 0.05),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               size = 0.5) -> scale_independence_plot

# Plot mean connectivity vs. soft thresholding power
data.frame(Indices = sft$fitIndices[,1],
           meanApprox = sft$fitIndices[,5]) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(x = Indices, y = meanApprox), color = "red", alpha = 0.1, size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(mapping = aes(x = Indices, y = meanApprox, label = Indices), color = "red", size = 4) +
  xlab("Soft Threshold (power)") +
  ylab("Mean Connectivity") +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_segment(aes(x = st - 0.4, 
                   y = sft$fitIndices$mean.k.[idx], 
                   xend = 0, 
                   yend = sft$fitIndices$mean.k.[idx]),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               size = 0.4) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Mean Connectivity: ", round(sft$fitIndices$mean.k.[idx], 2))) -> mean_connectivity_plot

# Set label size for plot grid
plot_labeling_size <- 15
```

```{r , fig.align='center', fig.height=14, fig.width=12}
# Function to calculate within-module correlations
corr_within_module <- function(exposures_Normalized, modules, module_x = 1){
  idx.exposures_Normalized <- which(modules$colors == module_x)
  idx.me <- which(colnames(modules$MEs) == paste0("ME", module_x))
  kME_x <- bicor(exposures_Normalized[, idx.exposures_Normalized], modules$MEs[, idx.me], maxPOutliers = 0.05)
  kME_x
}

# Generate density plots for all modules
ggplot.list <- list()

for(m in colnames(stage2results_transcriptomics$modules$MEs)){
  h <- as.numeric(sub("ME", "", m))
  data.frame(x = suppressWarnings(corr_within_module(exposures_Normalized = exposures_Normalized, modules = stage2results_transcriptomics$modules, module_x = h))) %>% 
    ggplot() + 
    geom_histogram(aes(x), fill = labels2colors(h), color = "black", alpha = 0.5, bins = 20) + 
    xlim(-1, 1) +
    theme_bw() +
    xlab("Metabolite Correlation") +
    ggtitle(paste0(prefix, "_", m)) -> da_plot
  
  ggplot.list[[m]] <- da_plot
}

ggplot.list <- ggplot.list[ggplot.list %>% names() %>% sub("ME", "", .) %>% as.numeric() %>% order()]

# Combine density plots for all modules into a grid
cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = ggplot.list, ncol = 6) -> density_all_plot

cowplot::plot_grid(part_2, density_all_plot, ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.8, 1), labels = c("", "F"), label_size = plot_labeling_size)
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.width=14, fig.height=9}
# Define numbers of genes and samples
exposures_Normalized <- t(assay(vst(dds)))

nGenes = ncol(exposures_Normalized);
nSamples = nrow(exposures_Normalized);
moduleLabels = stage2results_transcriptomics$modules$colors

# Recalculate MEs with color labels
MEs0 = moduleEigengenes(exposures_Normalized, moduleLabels)$eigengenes
MEs0$ME0 <- NULL
MEs = orderMEs(MEs0)
transcriptomics_MEs <- MEs
#phenotype_Female$Menopause_YN <- NULL
df <- phenotype_subset
df$Gender_M0F1 <- ifelse(df$Gender_M0F1 == "Male", 0, 1)
df$Steatosis <- ifelse(df$steatosis_Kleiner == 0, 0, 1)
df$Inflammation <- ifelse(df$inflammation_Kleiner == 0, 0, 1)
df$Fibrosis <- ifelse(df$fibrosis_Kleiner_04 == 0, 0, 1)


df$steatosis_Kleiner <- NULL
df$inflammation_Kleiner <- NULL
df$ballooning_Kleiner <- NULL
df$NASH_Kleiner_YN <- NULL
df$fibrosis_Kleiner_04 <- NULL
df$NAS_score <- NULL
df$MASH  <- NULL
df$Menopause_YN <- NULL
# Check the transformation
table(df$Gender_M0F1)


df <- df %>%
  dplyr::rename(
    Age = Age_yr,
    Gender = Gender_M0F1,
    BMI = BMI_kgm2,
    Glucose = Glucose_mgdL,
    HbA1c = HbA1c_percent,
    AST = AST_UL,
    ALT = ALT_UL,
    GGT = GGT_UL,
    Cholesterol = Cholesterol_mgdL,
    HDL = HDL_mgdL,
    LDL = LDL_mgdL,
    Triglycerides = TG_mgdL,
    Steatosis = Steatosis,
    Inflammation = Inflammation,
    Fibrosis = Fibrosis
  )




#phenotype$Gender_M0F1 <- NULL
moduleTraitCor = cor(MEs, df, use = "p");
moduleTraitPvalue = corPvalueStudent(moduleTraitCor, nSamples);

# Will display correlations and their p-values
textMatrix =  paste(signif(moduleTraitCor, 2), "\n(",
                           signif(moduleTraitPvalue, 1), ")", sep = "");
dim(textMatrix) = dim(moduleTraitCor)
heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#4575B4", "white", "#ffa500ff"))(51)
par(mar = c(12, 4, 2, 2) + 0.1)  # c(bottom, left, top, right)
# Display the correlation values within a heatmap plot
labeledHeatmap(Matrix = moduleTraitCor,
               xLabels = names(df),
               yLabels = names(MEs),
               ySymbols = names(MEs),
               colorLabels = FALSE,
               colors = heatmap_colors,
               textMatrix = textMatrix,
               setStdMargins = FALSE,
               cex.text = 0.5,
               zlim = c(-1,1),
               cluster_rows = T,
               main = paste("Module-trait relationships"))
```

```{r}
df_male <- df[df$Gender == 0, ]
df_female <- df[df$Gender == 1, ]
# Define a function for correlation and rotated heatmap plotting
plot_module_trait_correlation <- function(MEs, df_subset, gender_label) {
  nSamples <- nrow(df_subset)
  
  # Correlation and p-values
  moduleTraitCor <- cor(MEs[rownames(df_subset), ], df_subset, use = "p", method = "spearman")
  moduleTraitPvalue <- corPvalueStudent(moduleTraitCor, nSamples)
  
  # Significance stars
  signif_matrix <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(moduleTraitCor), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitCor))
  signif_matrix[moduleTraitPvalue <= 0.001] <- "***"
  signif_matrix[moduleTraitPvalue > 0.001 & moduleTraitPvalue <= 0.01] <- "**"
  signif_matrix[moduleTraitPvalue > 0.01 & moduleTraitPvalue <= 0.05] <- "*"
  
  # Combine as annotation matrix
  textMatrix <- matrix(paste(signif_matrix), 
                       nrow = nrow(moduleTraitCor), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitCor))
  
  # Transpose correlation and annotation matrices
  moduleTraitCor_t <- t(moduleTraitCor)
  textMatrix_t <- t(textMatrix)

  range_limit <- 0.6
  breaks <- seq(from = -range_limit, to = range_limit, length.out = 51)
  
  # Plot heatmap (rotated)
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat = moduleTraitCor_t,
    color =  colorRampPalette(c("#4575B4", "white", "#ffa500ff"))(51),
    display_numbers = textMatrix_t,
    number_color = "black",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    main = paste("Transcriptomics"),
    fontsize_number = 8,
    breaks = breaks,
    treeheight_row = 0,
    treeheight_col = 0
  )
}
```

```{r}

plot_module_trait_correlation <- function(MEs, df_subset, plot_title = "Module-Trait Relationships") {
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  
  nSamples <- nrow(df_subset)
  
  # Correlation matrix
  moduleTraitCor <- cor(MEs[rownames(df_subset), ], df_subset, use = "p", method = "spearman")
  moduleTraitPvalue <- corPvalueStudent(moduleTraitCor, nSamples)
  
  # FDR correction
  pval_adjusted <- p.adjust(as.vector(moduleTraitPvalue), method = "fdr")
  fdr_matrix <- matrix(pval_adjusted, nrow = nrow(moduleTraitPvalue), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitPvalue))
  
  # Create significance stars
  signif_matrix <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(moduleTraitCor), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitCor))
  signif_matrix[fdr_matrix <= 0.001] <- "***"
  signif_matrix[fdr_matrix > 0.001 & fdr_matrix <= 0.01] <- "**"
  signif_matrix[fdr_matrix > 0.01 & fdr_matrix <= 0.1] <- "*"
  
  # Transpose for heatmap orientation
  moduleTraitCor <- t(moduleTraitCor)
  signif_matrix <- t(signif_matrix)
  
  # Heatmap color settings
  heatmap_colors <-  colorRampPalette(c("#4575B4", "white", "#ffa500ff"))(51)
  range_limit <- 0.6
  breaks <- seq(from = -range_limit, to = range_limit, length.out = 51)
  
  # Plot heatmap
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat = moduleTraitCor,
    color = heatmap_colors,
    display_numbers = signif_matrix,
    number_color = "black",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    main = plot_title,
    fontsize_number = 8,
    breaks = breaks,
    treeheight_row = 0,
    treeheight_col = 0, show_rownames = T, legend = T 
  )
}
df_male <- df[df$Gender == 0, ]
df_female <- df[df$Gender == 1, ]
df_male$Gender <- NULL
df_female$Gender <- NULL


# Call the function for male and female data
plot_transcriptomics <- plot_module_trait_correlation(MEs, df, "Transcriptomics: All")
plot_module_trait_correlation(MEs, df_male, "Transcriptomics: Male")
plot_module_trait_correlation(MEs, df_female, "Transcriptomics: Female")
```

```{r, message=FALSE, error=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=12, fig.width=12}
library(dplyr)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(ggplot2)

# Function to get module-trait significance
get_module_trait_significance <- function(MEs, df_subset, traits = c("Steatosis", "Inflammation", "Fibrosis")) {
  nSamples <- nrow(df_subset)
  moduleCor <- cor(MEs[rownames(df_subset), ], df_subset[, traits, drop = FALSE], method = "spearman", use = "p")
  moduleP <- corPvalueStudent(moduleCor, nSamples)
  fdr <- matrix(p.adjust(as.vector(moduleP), method = "fdr"), nrow = nrow(moduleP), ncol = ncol(moduleP),
                dimnames = dimnames(moduleP))
  signif <- fdr <= 0.1
  list(cor = moduleCor, fdr = fdr, signif = signif)
}

# Subset by gender
df_male <- df[df$Gender == 0, ]; df_male$Gender <- NULL
df_female <- df[df$Gender == 1, ]; df_female$Gender <- NULL

# Get significant modules
male_sig <- get_module_trait_significance(MEs, df_male)
female_sig <- get_module_trait_significance(MEs, df_female)
sig_modules_male <- rownames(male_sig$signif)[apply(male_sig$signif, 1, any)]
sig_modules_female <- rownames(female_sig$signif)[apply(female_sig$signif, 1, any)]

# Filter genes for significant modules
sig_modules <- sig_modules_female  # or sig_modules_male
gene_module_key_filtered <- gene_module_key_trans %>%
  filter(module %in% sig_modules, module != "ME0") %>%
  group_by(module) %>%
  summarise(Genes = list(Genes)) %>%
  deframe()

# Map to Entrez IDs
moduleGeneSets.Entrez <- lapply(gene_module_key_filtered, function(genes) {
  entrez <- AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = sub("\\..*$", "", genes),
                                  column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first")
  na.omit(entrez)
})

# Background genes
all_genes <- na.omit(AnnotationDbi::mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys = rownames(dds),
                                            column = "ENTREZID", keytype = "ENSEMBL", multiVals = "first"))

# KEGG enrichment
ck <- compareCluster(geneCluster = moduleGeneSets.Entrez,
                     fun = "enrichKEGG", organism = "hsa",
                     pvalueCutoff = 0.05, qvalueCutoff = 0.1,
                     universe = all_genes)

# Module correlation sign
module_cor <- data.frame(module = rownames(female_sig$cor),
                         Direction = ifelse(female_sig$cor[,"Steatosis"] >= 0, "positive", "negative"))

# Prepare data for plotting
ck_df_plot <- as.data.frame(ck) %>%
  left_join(module_cor, by = c("Cluster" = "module")) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Direction)) %>%
  mutate(
    Phenotype = gsub("^ME", "TC_", Cluster),
    p_adjust_log = -log10(p.adjust)
  )

# Reorder KEGG pathways within each Category for better plotting
ck_df_plot <- ck_df_plot %>%
  group_by(category) %>%
  mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(unique(Description)))) %>%
  ungroup()

# Publication-ready KEGG dotplot
kegg_dotplot <- ggplot(ck_df_plot, aes(x = Phenotype, y = Description, 
                                       size = p_adjust_log, color = Direction)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0), alpha = 0.85, shape = 16) +
  facet_grid(category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("positive" = "#ffa500ff", "negative" = "#4575B4")) +
  scale_size_continuous(range = c(3, 8), name = "-log10(FDR)") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    size = "-log10(FDR)",
    color = "Correlation",
    x = "Module",
    y = "KEGG Pathway",
    title = "KEGG Pathway Enrichment by Cluster Correlation"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.spacing = unit(1.2, "lines"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

```{r}
# Example: your gene-module mapping
head(gene_module_key)

  # map to Entrez IDs

                                  keys = genes,
                                  column = "ENTREZID",
                                  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
                                  multiVals = "first")
```

```{r}
library(DESeq2)

# ------------------------------
# Common setup
# ------------------------------
dds$Gender <- factor(dds$Gender_M0F1)  # Male/Female



# ==========================================================
# --- Steatosis ---
# ==========================================================
dds$Steatosis <- ifelse(dds$steatosis_Kleiner == 0, 0, 1)
dds$Steatosis <- factor(dds$Steatosis, levels = c(0,1))  # 0 = ref

design(dds) <- ~ Age_yr + BMI_kgm2 + Gender + Steatosis
dds_steatosis <- DESeq(dds)

res_steatosis <- results(dds_steatosis, contrast = c("Steatosis","1","0"), alpha = 0.05)
res_steatosis <- res_steatosis[!is.na(res_steatosis$padj), ]

resLFC_steatosis <- lfcShrink(dds_steatosis, coef = "Steatosis_1_vs_0", type = "apeglm")

up_in_steatosis   <- subset(resLFC_steatosis, log2FoldChange > 0 & padj < 0.05)
down_in_steatosis <- subset(resLFC_steatosis, log2FoldChange < 0 & padj < 0.05)

up_entrez_steatosis   <- bitr(rownames(up_in_steatosis), fromType = "ENSEMBL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)
down_entrez_steatosis <- bitr(rownames(down_in_steatosis), fromType = "ENSEMBL", toType = "ENTREZID", OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db)

# GO
ego_up_steatosis <- enrichGO(gene = up_entrez_steatosis$ENTREZID, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                             ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "fdr", qvalueCutoff = 0.1, readable = TRUE)
ego_down_steatosis <- enrichGO(gene = down_entrez_steatosis$ENTREZID, OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
                               ont = "BP", pAdjustMethod = "fdr", qvalueCutoff = 0.1, readable = TRUE)

# KEGG (filter FDR < 0.1 manually)

ekegg_up_steatosis@result <- subset(ekegg_up_steatosis@result, qvalue < 0.1)

dotplot(ego_down_steatosis, showCategory = 15, title = "GO BP - Downregulated in Steatosis (FDR < 0.1)")
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(enrichplot)

# ------------------------------
# --- Step 1: Function to get top n terms (FDR < 0.1)
# ------------------------------
get_top_terms <- function(enrichObj, phenotype, direction, top_n = 10, fdr_cutoff = 0.1) {
  enrichObj@result %>%
    filter(qvalue < fdr_cutoff) %>%           # only keep FDR < 0.1
    arrange(p.adjust) %>%
    head(top_n) %>%
    mutate(Phenotype = phenotype,
           Direction = direction)
}

# ------------------------------
# --- Step 2: GO enrichment - top terms
# ------------------------------
go_top <- bind_rows(
  get_top_terms(ego_up_steatosis, "Steatosis", "Up"),
  get_top_terms(ego_down_steatosis, "Steatosis", "Down"),
  get_top_terms(ego_up_inflammation, "Inflammation", "Up"),
  get_top_terms(ego_down_inflammation, "Inflammation", "Down"),
  get_top_terms(ego_up_fibrosis, "Fibrosis", "Up"),
  get_top_terms(ego_down_fibrosis, "Fibrosis", "Down")
)
go_top$Phenotype <- factor(go_top$Phenotype, levels = c("Steatosis", "Inflammation", "Fibrosis"))
go_top$Type <- "GO BP"

# ------------------------------
# --- Step 3: KEGG enrichment - top terms
# ------------------------------
kegg_top <- bind_rows(
  get_top_terms(ekegg_up_steatosis, "Steatosis", "Up"),
  get_top_terms(ekegg_down_steatosis, "Steatosis", "Down"),
  get_top_terms(ekegg_up_inflammation, "Inflammation", "Up"),
  get_top_terms(ekegg_down_inflammation, "Inflammation", "Down"),
  get_top_terms(ekegg_up_fibrosis, "Fibrosis", "Up"),
  get_top_terms(ekegg_down_fibrosis, "Fibrosis", "Down")
)
kegg_top$Phenotype <- factor(kegg_top$Phenotype, levels = c("Steatosis", "Inflammation", "Fibrosis"))
kegg_top$Type <- "KEGG"

# ------------------------------
# --- Step 4: Combine GO and KEGG
# ------------------------------
combined_top <- bind_rows(go_top, kegg_top)

# Order Description by Phenotype and Direction for better plotting
combined_top <- combined_top %>%
  group_by(Phenotype, Direction, Type) %>%
  mutate(Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(unique(Description)))) %>%
  ungroup()

# ------------------------------
# --- Step 5: Plot
# ------------------------------
ggplot(combined_top, aes(x = Phenotype, y = Description, size = -log10(p.adjust), color = Direction)) +
  geom_point(position = position_jitter(width = 0.2, height = 0), alpha = 0.8) +
  facet_wrap(~Type, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#ffa500ff", "Down" = "#4575B4")) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 12) +
  labs(size = "-log10(FDR)", color = "Direction", x = "", y = "Term / Pathway") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 9, color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        strip.text = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
```

```{r}
library(KEGGREST)
library(dplyr)
library(KEGGREST)
library(dplyr)

# ------------------------------
# --- Step 1: Get unique KEGG pathway IDs
# ------------------------------
kegg_ids <- kegg_top$ID

# ------------------------------
# --- Step 2: Function to fetch KEGG category
# ------------------------------
get_kegg_category <- function(pathway_id) {
  info <- tryCatch(keggGet(pathway_id)[[1]], error = function(e) NULL)
  if (!is.null(info$CLASS)) {
    return(info$CLASS[1])  # e.g., "Metabolism; Lipid metabolism"
  } else {
    return(NA)
  }
}

# ------------------------------
# --- Step 3: Fetch categories for all pathways
# ------------------------------
categories <- sapply(kegg_ids, get_kegg_category)

# ------------------------------
# --- Step 4: Add to dataframe and split main/subcategory
# ------------------------------
kegg_top <- kegg_top %>%
  mutate(Category = categories,
         Main_Category = sapply(strsplit(Category, ";"), `[`, 1),
         Sub_Category  = sapply(strsplit(Category, ";"), `[`, 2))



kegg_top$category[kegg_top$ID == "hsa04820"] <- "Cellular Processes"
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=7, fig.width=12}
  labs(size = "-log10(FDR)", color = "Direction", x = "Phenotype", y = "KEGG Pathway") +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 10, color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
        axis.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
        strip.text.y = element_text(angle = 0, size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
        panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor = element_blank())

# ------------------------------
# --- Map Ensembl to gene symbols for Volcano plots
# ------------------------------
resLFC_steatosis$Gene <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys=rownames(resLFC_steatosis), column="SYMBOL", keytype="ENSEMBL", multiVals="first")
resLFC_inflammation$Gene <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys=rownames(resLFC_inflammation), column="SYMBOL", keytype="ENSEMBL", multiVals="first")
resLFC_fibrosis$Gene <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db, keys=rownames(resLFC_fibrosis), column="SYMBOL", keytype="ENSEMBL", multiVals="first")

# Volcano function
make_volcano <- function(res_obj, title_text) {
  col_vector <- ifelse(res_obj$padj < 0.05 & res_obj$log2FoldChange > 1, "#ffa500ff",
                       ifelse(res_obj$padj < 0.05 & res_obj$log2FoldChange < -1, "#4575B4", "grey"))
  EnhancedVolcano(res_obj,
                  lab = res_obj$Gene,
                  x = 'log2FoldChange',
                  y = 'padj',
                  pCutoff = 0.05,
                  FCcutoff = 1,
                  colCustom = col_vector,
                  title = title_text,
                  subtitle = NULL,
                  labSize = 4,
                  pointSize = 2.5,
                  colAlpha = 0.8,
                  legendPosition = 'none')
}

volcano_steatosis <- make_volcano(resLFC_steatosis, "Steatosis")
volcano_inflammation <- make_volcano(resLFC_inflammation, "Inflammation")
volcano_fibrosis <- make_volcano(resLFC_fibrosis, "Fibrosis")

# ------------------------------
# --- Prepare gene lists for Venn diagrams
# ------------------------------
up_lists <- list(
  Steatosis = rownames(subset(resLFC_steatosis, log2FoldChange > 0 & padj < 0.05)),
  Inflammation = rownames(subset(resLFC_inflammation, log2FoldChange > 0 & padj < 0.05)),
  Fibrosis = rownames(subset(resLFC_fibrosis, log2FoldChange > 0 & padj < 0.05))
)

down_lists <- list(
  Steatosis = rownames(subset(resLFC_steatosis, log2FoldChange < 0 & padj < 0.05)),
  Inflammation = rownames(subset(resLFC_inflammation, log2FoldChange < 0 & padj < 0.05)),
  Fibrosis = rownames(subset(resLFC_fibrosis, log2FoldChange < 0 & padj < 0.05))
)

# Venn plots
venn_up <- ggvenn(up_lists,
                  fill_color = c("#ffa500ff","#ffa500ff","#ffa500ff"),
                  stroke_size = 0.5, set_name_size = 5, text_size = 4) +
  ggtitle("Up-regulated DEGs") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold", size=14),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill="white", color=NA))

venn_down <- ggvenn(down_lists,
                    fill_color = c("#4575B4","#4575B4","#4575B4"),
                    stroke_size = 0.5, set_name_size = 5, text_size = 4) +
  ggtitle("Down-regulated DEGs") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust=0.5, face="bold", size=14),
        panel.background = element_rect(fill="white", color=NA))

# ------------------------------
# --- Arrange combined figure
# ------------------------------
# Top row: Volcano plots
row1 <- plot_grid(volcano_steatosis, volcano_inflammation, volcano_fibrosis,
                  ncol = 3, align = 'h', labels = c("A"), label_size = 16)

# Left column: Venn diagrams
venn_col <- plot_grid(venn_up, venn_down, ncol=1, rel_heights=c(1,1), labels=c("B"), label_size=16)

# Right column: KEGG
kegg_col <- ggplotGrob(kegg_dotplot)

# Bottom row: Venn + KEGG
bottom_row <- plot_grid(venn_col, kegg_col, labels=c("","C"), ncol=2, rel_widths=c(1,1.5), align='v', label_size=16)

# Final figure
final_plot <- plot_grid(row1, bottom_row, ncol=1, rel_heights=c(1,1.5))

# Save
ggsave("DEGs_Volcano_KEGG_Venn_WhiteBG.png", final_plot, width=19, height=15, dpi=300)

final_plot


```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

# ------------------------------
# Step 1: Combine up/down DEGs with direction
# ------------------------------
all_lists_dir <- bind_rows(
  data.frame(Gene = up_lists$Steatosis, Steatosis = 1, Inflammation = 0, Fibrosis = 0, Direction="Up"),
  data.frame(Gene = up_lists$Inflammation, Steatosis = 0, Inflammation = 1, Fibrosis = 0, Direction="Up"),
  data.frame(Gene = up_lists$Fibrosis, Steatosis = 0, Inflammation = 0, Fibrosis = 1, Direction="Up"),
  data.frame(Gene = down_lists$Steatosis, Steatosis = 1, Inflammation = 0, Fibrosis = 0, Direction="Down"),
  data.frame(Gene = down_lists$Inflammation, Steatosis = 0, Inflammation = 1, Fibrosis = 0, Direction="Down"),
  data.frame(Gene = down_lists$Fibrosis, Steatosis = 0, Inflammation = 0, Fibrosis = 1, Direction="Down")
)

# ------------------------------
# Step 2: Summarize each gene to ensure unique entries
# ------------------------------
venn_table_fixed <- all_lists_dir %>%
  group_by(Gene, Direction) %>%
  summarise(
    Steatosis = max(Steatosis),
    Inflammation = max(Inflammation),
    Fibrosis = max(Fibrosis),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# ------------------------------
# Step 3: Map gene symbols from ENSEMBL IDs
# ------------------------------
venn_table_fixed$Symbol <- mapIds(
  org.Hs.eg.db,
  keys = venn_table_fixed$Gene,
  column = "SYMBOL",
  keytype = "ENSEMBL",
  multiVals = "first"
)

# ------------------------------
# Step 4: Add simple statistics for each gene
# ------------------------------
venn_table_fixed <- venn_table_fixed %>%
  mutate(
    Total_Phenotypes = Steatosis + Inflammation + Fibrosis
  )

# ------------------------------
# Step 5: Optional: sort by total phenotypes or direction
# ------------------------------
venn_table_fixed <- venn_table_fixed %>%
  arrange(desc(Total_Phenotypes), Direction, Symbol)

# ------------------------------
# Step 6: Inspect
# ------------------------------
DT::datatable(venn_table_fixed)

# ------------------------------
# Step 7: Save as supplementary table
# ------------------------------
write.csv(venn_table_fixed, "Supplementary_Table_Venn_DEGs.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

#### Figurs S
Association between PI3K–Akt pathway activation and bile acid levels in liver samples.
Scatter plot showing the correlation between PI3K–Akt pathway scores, calculated as the average normalized expression of PI3K–Akt pathway genes (KEGG hsa04151) in liver transcriptomics data, and bile acid levels, computed as the mean intensity of primary and secondary bile acids from metabolomics data (CDCA, GCA, GCDCA, GDCA, GLCA, GUDCA, LCA, TCA, TCDCA, TDCA, THDCA, TLCA, TUDCA, ALLO_DCA, DCA). Spearman correlation was used to assess the association (rho = –0.223, p = 0.0022). The line represents the linear regression fit. This analysis suggests a modest inverse relationship between bile acid levels and transcriptional activity of the PI3K–Akt pathway in the liver.
```{r}
# --- 1. Load libraries ---
library(KEGGREST)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)
library(DESeq2)
library(ggplot2)

# --- 2. Get PI3K-Akt KEGG genes ---
pi3k_genes_raw <- keggGet("hsa04151")[[1]]$GENE
pi3k_genes <- pi3k_genes_raw[seq(2, length(pi3k_genes_raw), 2)]
pi3k_genes <- toupper(sub(";.*", "", pi3k_genes))  # clean gene symbols

# --- 3. Map gene symbols to Ensembl IDs ---
symbol2ensembl <- mapIds(org.Hs.eg.db,
                         keys=pi3k_genes,
                         column="ENSEMBL",
                         keytype="SYMBOL",
                         multiVals="first")
ensembl_pi3k <- na.omit(symbol2ensembl)

# --- 4. Subset normalized counts (dds object) for PI3K-Akt genes ---
norm_counts <- assay(vst(dds))  #counts(dds, normalized = TRUE)
pi3k_genes_present <- intersect(rownames(norm_counts), ensembl_pi3k)
pi3k_expr <- norm_counts[pi3k_genes_present, ]

# --- 5. Compute PI3K-Akt pathway score per sample ---
pi3k_score <- colMeans(pi3k_expr, na.rm=TRUE)

# --- 6. Compute bile acid score from metabolomics data ---
bile_metabolites <- c("CDCA","GCA","GHDCA","GCDCA","GDCA","GLCA","GUDCA",
                      "LCA","TCA","TCDCA","TDCA","THDCA","TLCA","TUDCA",
                      "ALLO_DCA","DCA")

bile_expr <- metabolomics_data[bile_metabolites, , drop=FALSE]
bile_score <- colMeans(bile_expr, na.rm=TRUE)

# --- 7. Keep common samples ---
common_samples <- intersect(names(pi3k_score), colnames(metabolomics_data))
pi3k_score_common <- pi3k_score[common_samples]
bile_score_common <- bile_score[common_samples]

# --- 8. Spearman correlation ---
cor_test <- cor.test(pi3k_score_common, bile_score_common, method="spearman")

# --- 9. Scatter plot ---
df_plot <- data.frame(PI3K_Score=pi3k_score_common, Bile_Score=bile_score_common)

# Create the publication-ready plot with SE ribbon
ggplot(df_plot, aes(x = Bile_Score, y = PI3K_Score)) +
  geom_point(color = "#377eb8", size = 3, alpha = 0.7) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", color = "#e41a1c", se = TRUE, linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1) + # Set se to TRUE
  theme_classic(base_size = 14) +
  xlab("Average Bile Acid Level") +
  ylab("PI3K-Akt Pathway Score") +
  ggtitle("Correlation between PI3K-Akt Pathway Activity and Bile Acid Levels") +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = 16),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.margin = unit(c(1, 1, 1, 1), "cm")
  ) +
  annotate("text",
           x = max(df_plot$Bile_Score) - (max(df_plot$Bile_Score) - min(df_plot$Bile_Score)) * 0.05,
           y = max(df_plot$PI3K_Score) - (max(df_plot$PI3K_Score) - min(df_plot$PI3K_Score)) * 0.05,
           label = paste0("Spearman ρ = ", round(cor_test$estimate, 3),
                          "\np-value = ", format.pval(cor_test$p.value, digits = 3, eps = 0.001)),
           hjust = 1, vjust = 1, size = 5, fontface = "bold"
  )

```

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}

# exposures_Normalized <- exposures_Normalized %>% dplyr::select(-LIVMF44)


phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars <- phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars[rownames(phenotype_Serum_PolarSemipolars) != "MF138", ]


exposures_Normalized <-  t(exposures_Normalized)
dim(exposures_Normalized) %>% paste(c("Samples", "Metabolites"))



powers <- c(1:10, seq(12,30,2))
sft <- pickSoftThreshold(exposures_Normalized, 
                         powerVector = powers, 
                         verbose = 1, 
                         networkType = "signed",
                         corFn = "bicor")

# Identify the appropriate soft thresholding power (st)
idx <- min(which((-sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2]) > 0.90))
if (is.infinite(idx)) {
  idx <- min(which((-sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2]) > 0.80))
  if (!is.infinite(idx)) {
    st <- sft$fitIndices[idx,1]
  } else {
    idx <- which.max(-sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2])
    st <- sft$fitIndices[idx,1]
  }
} else {
  st <- sft$fitIndices[idx,1]
}

# Plot scale independence vs. soft thresholding power
data.frame(Indices = sft$fitIndices[,1],
           sfApprox = -sign(sft$fitIndices[,3]) * sft$fitIndices[,2]) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.9, color = "red", alpha = 0.6) +  # R^2 cut-off of 0.9
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0.8, color = "red", alpha = 0.2) +  # R^2 cut-off of 0.8
  geom_line(aes(x = Indices, y = sfApprox), color = "red", alpha = 0.1, size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(mapping = aes(x = Indices, y = sfApprox, label = Indices), color = "red", size = 4) +
  ggtitle("Scale Independence") +
  xlab("Soft Threshold (power)") +
  ylab("SF Model Fit, signed R^2") +
  xlim(1, 30) + 
  theme_bw() +
  ylim(-1, 1) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = st, y = 0.25, xend = st, yend = sfApprox[idx] - 0.05),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               size = 0.5) -> scale_independence_plot

# Plot mean connectivity vs. soft thresholding power
data.frame(Indices = sft$fitIndices[,1],
           meanApprox = sft$fitIndices[,5]) %>% 
  ggplot() + 
  geom_line(aes(x = Indices, y = meanApprox), color = "red", alpha = 0.1, size = 2.5) +
  geom_text(mapping = aes(x = Indices, y = meanApprox, label = Indices), color = "red", size = 4) +
  xlab("Soft Threshold (power)") +
  ylab("Mean Connectivity") +
  theme_bw() +
  geom_segment(aes(x = st - 0.4, 
                   y = sft$fitIndices$mean.k.[idx], 
                   xend = 0, 
                   yend = sft$fitIndices$mean.k.[idx]),
               arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.2, "cm")),
               size = 0.4) +
  ggtitle(paste0("Mean Connectivity: ", round(sft$fitIndices$mean.k.[idx], 2))) -> mean_connectivity_plot

# Set label size for plot grid
plot_labeling_size <- 15
```

```{r}
plot_module_trait_correlation <- function(MEs, df_subset, gender_label) {
  nSamples <- nrow(df_subset)
  
  moduleTraitCor <- cor(MEs[rownames(df_subset), ], df_subset, use = "p", method = "spearman")
  moduleTraitPvalue <- corPvalueStudent(moduleTraitCor, nSamples)
  
  # Significance matrix
  signif_matrix <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(moduleTraitCor), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitCor))
  three_star <- which(moduleTraitPvalue <= 0.001, arr.ind = TRUE)
  two_star <- which((moduleTraitPvalue <= 0.01) & (moduleTraitPvalue > 0.001), arr.ind = TRUE)
  one_star <- which((moduleTraitPvalue <= 0.05) & (moduleTraitPvalue > 0.01), arr.ind = TRUE)
  signif_matrix[three_star] <- "***"
  signif_matrix[two_star] <- "**"
  signif_matrix[one_star] <- "*"
  
  # Combine correlation values with significance levels
  textMatrix <- matrix(paste(signif_matrix), 
                       nrow = nrow(moduleTraitCor), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitCor))
  
  # Transpose the matrices to reverse (flip) the plot
  moduleTraitCor <- t(moduleTraitCor)
  textMatrix <- t(textMatrix)
  
  # Set heatmap colors
  heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#4575B4", "white", "#ffa500ff"))(51)
  
  # Custom blue-red diverging palette
  range_limit <- 0.6
  breaks <- seq(from = -range_limit, to = range_limit, length.out = 51)
  
  # Plot the transposed heatmap
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat = moduleTraitCor,
    color = heatmap_colors,
    display_numbers = textMatrix,
    number_color = "black",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    main = paste("Serum: Polar-Semipolars"),
    fontsize_number = 8,
    breaks = breaks,
    treeheight_row = 0,
    treeheight_col = 0
  )
}
```

#### With FDR (BH p-value <0.1)
```{r}
plot_module_trait_correlation <- function(MEs, df_subset, plot_title = "Module-Trait Relationships") {
  library(pheatmap)
  library(RColorBrewer)
  
  nSamples <- nrow(df_subset)
  
  # Correlation matrix
  moduleTraitCor <- cor(MEs[rownames(df_subset), ], df_subset, use = "p", method = "spearman")
  moduleTraitPvalue <- corPvalueStudent(moduleTraitCor, nSamples)
  
  # FDR correction
  pval_adjusted <- p.adjust(as.vector(moduleTraitPvalue), method = "fdr")
  fdr_matrix <- matrix(pval_adjusted, nrow = nrow(moduleTraitPvalue), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitPvalue))
  
  # Create significance stars
  signif_matrix <- matrix("", nrow = nrow(moduleTraitCor), ncol = ncol(moduleTraitCor))
  signif_matrix[fdr_matrix <= 0.001] <- "***"
  signif_matrix[fdr_matrix > 0.001 & fdr_matrix <= 0.01] <- "**"
  signif_matrix[fdr_matrix > 0.01 & fdr_matrix <= 0.1] <- "*"
  
  # Transpose for heatmap orientation
  moduleTraitCor <- t(moduleTraitCor)
  signif_matrix <- t(signif_matrix)
   # Set heatmap colors
  heatmap_colors <- colorRampPalette(c("#4575B4", "white", "#ffa500ff"))(51)
  
  # Custom blue-red diverging palette
  range_limit <- 0.6
  breaks <- seq(from = -range_limit, to = range_limit, length.out = 51)
  
  # Plot heatmap
  pheatmap::pheatmap(
    mat = moduleTraitCor,
    color = heatmap_colors,
    display_numbers = signif_matrix,
    number_color = "black",
    cluster_rows = FALSE,
    cluster_cols = FALSE,
    main = plot_title,
    fontsize_number = 8,
    breaks = breaks,
    treeheight_row = 0,   
    treeheight_col = 0, 
    show_rownames = T, 
    legend = T
  )
}


# Call the function for male and female data
plot_serum_metabolomics <- plot_module_trait_correlation(MEs, df, "Serum: Polar-Semipolars")
plot_module_trait_correlation(MEs, df_male, "Serum: Polar-Semipolars (Male)")
plot_module_trait_correlation(MEs, df_female, "Serum: Polar-Semipolars (Female)")
```

### Table
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(tibble)
library(DT)

# Classify metabolite names as identified / putative / unknown
classify_metabolite <- function(name) {
  name <- tolower(name)
  if (str_detect(name, "unknown")) {
    return("unknown")
  } else if (str_detect(name, "putative|likely|predicted")) {
    return("putative")
  } else {
    return("identified")
  }
}



# Apply classification to each metabolite
gene_module_key_classified <- serum_gene_module_key %>%
  mutate(class = sapply(Metabolites, classify_metabolite))

# Extract hub metabolite per module and rename appropriately
top_genes <- stage2results_Serum_Semipolar$hubs %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename("Hub name" = ".") %>%
  tibble::rownames_to_column(var = "module") %>%
  mutate(module = paste0("ME", module))  # Ensure format matches 'gene_module_key'

# Create final summary table with improved content summary
summary_table <- gene_module_key_classified %>%
  group_by(module) %>%
  summarise(
    Cluster_number = unique(module),
    N_identified = sum(class == "identified"),
    N_putative = sum(class == "putative"),
    N_unknown = sum(class == "unknown"),
    N_total = n(),
    Content_summary = {
      # Extract metabolite names per class
      identified_names <- Metabolites[class == "identified"]
      putative_names <- Metabolites[class == "putative"]
      unknown_names <- Metabolites[class == "unknown"]
      
      # Collapse into a single string
      summary_list <- c(identified_names, putative_names)
      if (length(unknown_names) > 0) {
        summary_list <- c(summary_list, unknown_names[1])  # Add only one 'unknown'
      }
      paste(summary_list, collapse = ", ")
    }
  ) %>%
  left_join(top_genes, by = c("module")) %>%
  select(
    Cluster_number,
    N_identified,
    N_putative,
    N_unknown,
    N_total,
    `Hub name`,
    Content_summary
  ) %>%
  arrange(Cluster_number)



# Step 5: View updated table
DT::datatable(summary_table)
```

### DEGs Metabolomics
```{r}
library(limma)

# Transpose matrix: rows = metabolites, columns = samples
metabo_mat <- t(as.matrix(exposures_Normalized))

# Check dimensions
dim(metabo_mat)
# Should be: features x samples, e.g., 701 x 189

# Ensure column names match metadata rownames
all(colnames(metabo_mat) == rownames(df))  # should be TRUE

# Phenotype metadata
metadata <- df
metadata$Steatosis <- factor(metadata$Steatosis, levels = c(0,1))
metadata$Inflammation <- factor(metadata$Inflammation, levels = c(0,1))
metadata$Fibrosis <- factor(metadata$Fibrosis, levels = c(0,1))
metadata$Gender <- factor(metadata$Gender, levels = c(0,1))  # 0 = Male, 1 = Female

# Differential analysis function
run_diff <- function(phenotype){
  design <- model.matrix(~ Age + BMI + Gender + metadata[[phenotype]], data = metadata)
  
  fit <- lmFit(metabo_mat, design)
  fit <- eBayes(fit)
  
  # Coefficient of interest = last column (phenotype effect)
  coef_name <- ncol(design)
  res <- topTable(fit, coef = coef_name, number = Inf, adjust.method = "fdr")
  return(res)
}

# Run for each phenotype
res_steatosis <- run_diff("Steatosis")
res_inflammation <- run_diff("Inflammation")
res_fibrosis <- run_diff("Fibrosis")

# Filter significant metabolites (FDR < 0.1)
sig_steatosis <- res_steatosis[res_steatosis$adj.P.Val < 0.1, ]
sig_inflammation <- res_inflammation[res_inflammation$adj.P.Val < 0.1, ]
sig_fibrosis <- res_fibrosis[res_fibrosis$adj.P.Val < 0.1, ]

library(dplyr)

# Add phenotype and direction columns for each condition
sig_steatosis_tbl_serum <- sig_steatosis %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = "Steatosis",
         Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
         Metabolite = rownames(sig_steatosis)) %>%
  select(Metabolite, Phenotype, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction)

sig_inflammation_tbl_serum <- sig_inflammation %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = "Inflammation",
         Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
         Metabolite = rownames(sig_inflammation)) %>%
  select(Metabolite, Phenotype, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction)

sig_fibrosis_tbl_serum <- sig_fibrosis %>%
  mutate(Phenotype = "Fibrosis",
         Direction = ifelse(logFC > 0, "Up", "Down"),
         Metabolite = rownames(sig_fibrosis)) %>%
  select(Metabolite, Phenotype, logFC, AveExpr, t, P.Value, adj.P.Val, Direction)

# Combine all into a single table
combined_sig_tbl_serum <- bind_rows(sig_steatosis_tbl_serum, sig_inflammation_tbl_serum)

  arrange(Phenotype, desc(logFC))
combined_sig_tbl_serum$Tissue <- "Serum"
```
