# Figure 3
## Figure for Serum and Liver metabolomics

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)

# 1️⃣ Read / define your serum and biopsy significant metabolite tables
# Example: combined_sig_tbl_serum and combined_sig_tbl_biopsy
# These should have at least: Metabolite, Phenotype, Direction, Tissue
# Here we assume you already have them as data frames

# 2️⃣ Combine serum and biopsy tables
combined_sig_tbl <- bind_rows(combined_sig_tbl_serum, combined_sig_tbl_biospy)
library(dplyr)

# 1️⃣ Clean metabolite names
combined_sig_tbl <- combined_sig_tbl %>%
  mutate(
    Metabolite = gsub("\\.\\.\\..*", "", Metabolite), # remove ...1 suffixes
    Metabolite = toupper(trimws(Metabolite))          # uppercase and trim spaces
  )

# 2️⃣ Create metabolite-to-pathway mapping
metabolite_pathway_map <- data.frame(
  Metabolite = c(
    # Amino acids
    "ISOLEUCINE", "LEUCIN", "GLUTAMINE", "GLUTAMIC_ACID",
    "TRYPTOPHAN", "TAURINE", "METHIONINE", "PHENYLALANINE",
    "VALINE", "THREONINE", "ASPARTIC_ACID", "LYSINE",
    "SERINE", "AMINOBUTYRIC_ACID", "X3_METHYL_2_OXOVALERATE",
    
    # Fatty acids / PUFA
    "ARACHIDONIC_ACID", "CIS_8_11_14_17_EICOSATETRAENOIC_ACID", "HDCA",
    
    # Bile acids
    "ALLO_DCA", "GCA", "TCA", "TDCA",
    
    # Nucleotides
    "INOSINE", "HYPOXANTHINE",
    
    # Carbohydrates / other
    "MANNOSE_MYOINOSITOL", "QUINATE", "GALACTURONIC_ACID",
    
    # Ketone bodies
    "X2_HYDROXYBUTYRIC_ACID_3_HYDROXYBUTYRIC_ACID",
    
    # Other / putative metabolites will be annotated as "Other" later
    "PUTATIVE_OXYPURINOL", "PUTATIVE_CINNAMIC_ACID", 
    "PUTATIVE_TYROSOL_GLUCURONIDE_TYR_G",
    "PUTATIVE_N_2_HYDROXYPHENYL_ACETAMIDE_SULFATE_2_HPA_S",
    "PUTATIVE_P_COUMARIC_ACID_SULFATE_P_COU_S"
  ),
  Pathway = c(
    # Amino acids
    rep("Amino acid metabolism", 15),
    # Fatty acids
    rep("Fatty acid metabolism", 3),
    # Bile acids
    rep("Bile acid metabolism", 4),
    # Nucleotides
    rep("Nucleotide metabolism", 2),
    # Carbohydrates / other
    rep("Carbohydrate metabolism", 3),
    # Ketone bodies
    "Ketone metabolism",
    # Putative / other
    rep("Other", 5)
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# 3️⃣ Left join with main table and assign "Other" to unknowns
combined_sig_tbl <- combined_sig_tbl %>%
  left_join(metabolite_pathway_map, by = "Metabolite") %>%
  mutate(Pathway = ifelse(is.na(Pathway), "Other", Pathway))

# 4️⃣ Verify
table(combined_sig_tbl$Pathway)

library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)
library(patchwork)


# 2️⃣ Sankey input for Panel B
sankey_data <- combined_sig_tbl %>%
    filter(Pathway != "Other") %>%
    group_by(Tissue, Phenotype, Direction, Pathway) %>%
    summarise(Count = n_distinct(Metabolite), .groups = "drop")

sankey_data$Tissue <- factor(sankey_data$Tissue, levels = c("Biopsy", "Serum"))
sankey_data$Phenotype <- factor(sankey_data$Phenotype, levels = c("Inflammation", "Steatosis"))
sankey_data$Direction <- factor(sankey_data$Direction, levels = c("Up", "Down"))
sankey_data$Pathway <- factor(sankey_data$Pathway, levels = c(
    "Amino acid metabolism",
    "Fatty acid metabolism",
    "Bile acid metabolism",
    "Nucleotide metabolism",
    "Carbohydrate metabolism",
    "Ketone metabolism"
))


final_sankey <- ggplot(
    sankey_data,
    aes(
        axis1 = Tissue,
        axis2 = Phenotype,
        axis3 = Direction,
        axis4 = Pathway,
        y = Count
    )
) +
    geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Direction), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.8, color = "gray40") +
    geom_stratum(width = 0.25, fill = "grey95", color = "black") +
    geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 3.5) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("Up" = "#FFA500", "Down" = "#4575B4")) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Tissue", "Phenotype", "Direction", "Pathway")) +
    labs(
        title = "Metabolite Regulation Across MASLD Features",
        y = "Number of Metabolites",
        x = NULL,
        fill = "Direction"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
    theme(
        axis.text.y = element_text(),
        axis.ticks.y = element_line(),
        panel.grid = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0, hjust = 0.5, face = "bold"),
        plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold")
    )

# 4️⃣ Show plot
final_sankey
```

```{r}
library(ggalluvial)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(stringr)

# ---- Prepare Sankey data ----
sankey_data <- combined_sig_tbl %>%
  filter(Pathway != "Other") %>%
  group_by(Tissue, Phenotype, Direction, Pathway) %>%
  summarise(Count = n_distinct(Metabolite), .groups = "drop")

# ---- Factor ordering ----
sankey_data$Tissue <- factor(sankey_data$Tissue, levels = c("Biopsy", "Serum"))
sankey_data$Phenotype <- factor(sankey_data$Phenotype, levels = c("Steatosis", "Inflammation"))
sankey_data$Direction <- factor(sankey_data$Direction, levels = c("Up", "Down"))
sankey_data$Pathway <- factor(
  sankey_data$Pathway,
  levels = c(
    "Amino acid metabolism",
    "Fatty acid metabolism",
    "Bile acid metabolism",
    "Carbohydrate metabolism",
    "Ketone metabolism",
    "Nucleotide metabolism"
  )
)

# ---- Wrapped labels for pathways ----
sankey_data$Pathway_wrapped <- str_wrap(as.character(sankey_data$Pathway), width = 16)

# ---- Final Sankey plot ----
final_sankey <- ggplot(
  sankey_data,
  aes(
    axis1 = Tissue,
    axis2 = Phenotype,
    axis3 = Pathway_wrapped,
    y = Count
  )
) +
  geom_alluvium(
    aes(fill = Direction),
    width = 0.12,
    alpha = 0.85,
    color = "grey40"
  ) +
  geom_stratum(
    width = 0.38,
    fill = "grey95",
    color = "black"
  ) +
  geom_text(
    stat = "stratum",
    aes(label = after_stat(stratum)),
    size = 3.0,
    fontface = "bold",
    lineheight = 0.9
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c("Up" = "#FFA500", "Down" = "#4575B4"),
    guide = guide_legend(title = "Regulation")
  ) +
  scale_x_discrete(
    labels = c("Tissue", "Phenotype", "Pathway")
  ) +
  labs(
    y = "Number of metabolites",
    x = NULL
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.margin = margin(5, 25, 5, 25)
  )

# ---- Render ----
final_sankey
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=T, fig.align='center', fig.width=17, fig.height=8}
rename_ME_labels_force <- function(plot_obj, new_prefix) {
  for (i in seq_along(plot_obj$gtable$grobs)) {
    grob <- plot_obj$gtable$grobs[[i]]
    
    if (inherits(grob, "text") && any(grepl("^ME", grob$label))) {
      # Replace ME with desired prefix
      grob$label <- gsub("^ME", new_prefix, grob$label)
      plot_obj$gtable$grobs[[i]] <- grob
    }
  }
  return(plot_obj)
}

# Apply to each heatmap plot

plot_transcriptomics <- rename_ME_labels_force(plot_transcriptomics, "TC")
```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=T, fig.align='center', fig.width=17, fig.height=8}
)
```

# Chord diagram: only significant with Serum

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=6}
library(psych)
library(circlize)

df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(phenotype, "SampleID")
min_value_GGT_UL <- min(df$GGT_UL, na.rm = TRUE)
df$GGT_UL[is.na(df$GGT_UL)] <- min_value_GGT_UL / 2

df$Steatosis <- ifelse(df$Steatosis == 0, 0, 1)
df$Inflammation <- ifelse(df$Inflammation == 0, 0, 1)
df$Fibrosis <- ifelse(df$Fibrosis == 0, 0, 1)


df_male <- subset(df, df$Gender =="Male")
row.names(df_male) <- df_male$SampleID
df_female <- subset(df, df$Gender =="Female")
row.names(df_female) <- df_female$SampleID

samples_male <- rownames(df_male)
samples_female <- rownames(df_female)

# Subset and transpose each omics layer
# --- Metabolomics ---
met_male   <- t(metabolomics_MEs[intersect(samples_male, rownames(metabolomics_MEs)), ])
met_female <- t(metabolomics_MEs[intersect(samples_female, rownames(metabolomics_MEs)), ])

# --- Lipidomics ---
lip_male   <- t(lipidomics_MEs[intersect(samples_male, rownames(lipidomics_MEs)), ])
lip_female <- t(lipidomics_MEs[intersect(samples_female, rownames(lipidomics_MEs)), ])
serum_met_MEs <- serum_met_MEs.bk

rownames(serum_met_MEs) <- paste0("LIV", rownames(serum_met_MEs))
serum_met_MEs <- t(serum_met_MEs)
 
# --- PFAS (already in correct orientation: analyte x sample) ---
pfas_male   <- serum_met_MEs[, intersect(samples_male, colnames(serum_met_MEs))]
pfas_female <- serum_met_MEs[, intersect(samples_female, colnames(serum_met_MEs))]

# --- Transcriptomics ---
trans_male   <- t(transcriptomics_MEs[intersect(samples_male, rownames(transcriptomics_MEs)), ])
trans_female <- t(transcriptomics_MEs[intersect(samples_female, rownames(transcriptomics_MEs)), ])



hist_vars <- c("Steatosis", "Inflammation", "Fibrosis")

# Subset histology data
df_male_hist <- df_male[ , hist_vars]
df_female_hist <- df_female[ , hist_vars]

subset_hist_by_omics <- function(hist_df, omics_df) {
  common_ids <- intersect(rownames(hist_df), colnames(omics_df))
  hist_df[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
}

df_male_met   <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_male_hist, met_male)
df_male_lip   <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_male_hist, lip_male)
df_male_pfas  <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_male_hist, pfas_male)
df_male_trans <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_male_hist, trans_male)

df_female_met   <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_female_hist, met_female)
df_female_lip   <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_female_hist, lip_female)
df_female_pfas  <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_female_hist, pfas_female)
df_female_trans <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_female_hist, trans_female)



# Male correlations
cor_met_male   <- corr.test(t(met_male),   df_male_met,   method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")
cor_lip_male   <- corr.test(t(lip_male),   df_male_lip,   method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")
cor_pfas_male  <- corr.test(t(pfas_male),  df_male_pfas,  method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")
cor_trans_male <- corr.test(t(trans_male), df_male_trans, method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")

# Female correlations
cor_met_female   <- corr.test(t(met_female),   df_female_met,   method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")
cor_lip_female   <- corr.test(t(lip_female),   df_female_lip,   method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")
cor_pfas_female  <- corr.test(t(pfas_female),  df_female_pfas,  method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")
cor_trans_female <- corr.test(t(trans_female), df_female_trans, method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")


extract_sig_cor <- function(cor_obj, prefix) {
  sig_idx <- which(cor_obj$p.adj < 0.1, arr.ind = TRUE)
  if (length(sig_idx) == 0) return(data.frame())
  data.frame(
    source = paste0(prefix, "_", rownames(cor_obj$r)[sig_idx[, 1]]),
    target = colnames(cor_obj$r)[sig_idx[, 2]],
    correlation = cor_obj$r[sig_idx],
    pval = cor_obj$p.adj[sig_idx],
    col = ifelse(cor_obj$r[sig_idx] > 0, "red", "blue"),
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# Combine for each group
chord_all_male <- rbind(
  extract_sig_cor(cor_met_male, "Met"),
  extract_sig_cor(cor_lip_male, "Lip"),
  extract_sig_cor(cor_pfas_male, "Serum_Met"),
  extract_sig_cor(cor_trans_male, "Trans")
)

chord_all_female <- rbind(
  extract_sig_cor(cor_met_female, "Met"),
  extract_sig_cor(cor_lip_female, "Lip"),
  extract_sig_cor(cor_pfas_female, "Serum_Met"),
  extract_sig_cor(cor_trans_female, "Trans")
)

prepare_chord_data <- function(chord_df) {
  if (nrow(chord_df) == 0) return(NULL)
  chord_df$source_group <- gsub("_.*", "", chord_df$source)
  chord_df$target_group <- "Histology"
  
  nodes <- unique(c(chord_df$source, chord_df$target))
  node_groups <- c(
    setNames(chord_df$source_group, chord_df$source),
    setNames(chord_df$target_group, chord_df$target)
  )
  node_groups <- node_groups[!duplicated(names(node_groups))]
  
  group_color_map <- c(
    Met = "#1f77b4",
    Lip = "#2ca02c",
    Serum_Met = "#ff7f0e",
    Trans = "#e377c2",
    Histology = "#9467bd"
  )
  grid_colors <- setNames(group_color_map[as.character(node_groups)], names(node_groups))
  
  return(list(data = chord_df, grid.col = grid_colors, node_groups = node_groups))
}

plot_chord_pretty <- function(chord_df, title_text) {
  if (nrow(chord_df) == 0) {
    message("No significant associations.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  prep <- prepare_chord_data(chord_df)
  chord_data <- prep$data
  grid_colors <- prep$grid.col
  node_groups <- prep$node_groups
  
  chord_data$col <- ifelse(chord_data$correlation > 0, "#87cefacc", "#ffb6c1cc")
  circos.clear()
  
  chordDiagram(
    chord_data[, c("source", "target")],
    grid.col = grid_colors,
    col = chord_data$col,
    transparency = 0.3,
    directional = 1,
    annotationTrack = c( "grid"),
    preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.1)
  )
  
  circos.trackPlotRegion(
    track.index = 1,
    panel.fun = function(x, y) {
      sector_name <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
      xlim <- get.cell.meta.data("xlim")
      ylim <- get.cell.meta.data("ylim")
      circos.text(
        x = mean(xlim),
        y = ylim[1] + mm_y(2),
        labels = sector_name,
        facing = "clockwise",
        niceFacing = TRUE,
        adj = c(0, 0.5),
        cex = 0.8,
        col = grid_colors[sector_name]
      )
    },
    bg.border = NA
  )
  
  title(main = title_text, cex.main = 1.5)
  
  legend(
    "topleft",
    legend = c("Positive correlation", "Negative correlation"),
    col = c("#87cefa", "#ffb6c1"),
    lty = 1, lwd = 2, cex = 1.1, bty = "n", title = "Edge direction"
  )
  
  legend(
    "bottomleft",
    legend = c("Metabolomics", "Lipidomics", "Serum_Met", "Transcriptomics", "Histology"),
    fill = c("#1f77b4", "#2ca02c", "#ff7f0e", "#e377c2", "#9467bd"),
    border = NA,
    cex = 1.1, bty = "n", title = "Node type"
  )
}


# Coerce correlation column just in case
chord_all_male$correlation <- as.numeric(as.character(chord_all_male$correlation))
chord_all_female$correlation <- as.numeric(as.character(chord_all_female$correlation))

# Plot
plot_chord_pretty(chord_all_male, "Male: Omics-Histology Associations")
plot_chord_pretty(chord_all_female, "Female: Omics-Histology Associations")

```











# Chord diagram: All with Serum

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=10}
library(dplyr)
library(psych)
library(circlize)
library(tibble)

# --- Preprocessing ---
df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(phenotype, "SampleID")
min_value_GGT_UL <- min(df$GGT_UL, na.rm = TRUE)
df$GGT_UL[is.na(df$GGT_UL)] <- min_value_GGT_UL / 2

df$Steatosis <- ifelse(df$steatosis_Kleiner == 0, 0, 1)
df$Inflammation <- ifelse(df$inflammation_Kleiner == 0, 0, 1)
df$Fibrosis <- ifelse(df$fibrosis_Kleiner_04 == 0, 0, 1)

df_male <- subset(df, Gender_M0F1 == "Male")
df_female <- subset(df, Gender_M0F1 == "Female")
rownames(df_male) <- df_male$SampleID
rownames(df_female) <- df_female$SampleID

samples_male <- rownames(df_male)
samples_female <- rownames(df_female)

# --- Omics Subsetting ---
met_male   <- t(metabolomics_MEs[intersect(samples_male, rownames(metabolomics_MEs)), ])
met_female <- t(metabolomics_MEs[intersect(samples_female, rownames(metabolomics_MEs)), ])

lip_male   <- t(lipidomics_MEs[intersect(samples_male, rownames(lipidomics_MEs)), ])
lip_female <- t(lipidomics_MEs[intersect(samples_female, rownames(lipidomics_MEs)), ])

serum_met_MEs <- serum_met_MEs.bk
rownames(serum_met_MEs) <- paste0("LIV", rownames(serum_met_MEs))
serum_met_MEs <- t(serum_met_MEs)

pfas_male   <- serum_met_MEs[, intersect(samples_male, colnames(serum_met_MEs))]
pfas_female <- serum_met_MEs[, intersect(samples_female, colnames(serum_met_MEs))]

trans_male   <- t(transcriptomics_MEs[intersect(samples_male, rownames(transcriptomics_MEs)), ])
trans_female <- t(transcriptomics_MEs[intersect(samples_female, rownames(transcriptomics_MEs)), ])

# --- Histology ---
hist_vars <- c("Steatosis", "Inflammation", "Fibrosis")
df_male_hist   <- df_male[ , hist_vars]
df_female_hist <- df_female[ , hist_vars]

subset_hist_by_omics <- function(hist_df, omics_df) {
  common_ids <- intersect(rownames(hist_df), colnames(omics_df))
  hist_df[common_ids, , drop = FALSE]
}

# --- Histology subsets per omics layer ---
df_male_met   <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_male_hist, met_male)
df_male_lip   <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_male_hist, lip_male)
df_male_pfas  <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_male_hist, pfas_male)
df_male_trans <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_male_hist, trans_male)

df_female_met   <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_female_hist, met_female)
df_female_lip   <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_female_hist, lip_female)
df_female_pfas  <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_female_hist, pfas_female)
df_female_trans <- subset_hist_by_omics(df_female_hist, trans_female)

# --- Correlation analysis ---
cor_met_male   <- corr.test(t(met_male),   df_male_met,   method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")
cor_lip_male   <- corr.test(t(lip_male),   df_male_lip,   method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")
cor_pfas_male  <- corr.test(t(pfas_male),  df_male_pfas,  method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")
cor_trans_male <- corr.test(t(trans_male), df_male_trans, method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")

cor_met_female   <- corr.test(t(met_female),   df_female_met,   method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")
cor_lip_female   <- corr.test(t(lip_female),   df_female_lip,   method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")
cor_pfas_female  <- corr.test(t(pfas_female),  df_female_pfas,  method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")
cor_trans_female <- corr.test(t(trans_female), df_female_trans, method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr")

# --- Extract correlations ---
extract_all_cor <- function(cor_obj, prefix) {
  all_idx <- which(!is.na(cor_obj$r), arr.ind = TRUE)
  if (length(all_idx) == 0) return(data.frame())
  
  corr_vals <- cor_obj$r[all_idx]
  pvals <- cor_obj$p.adj[all_idx]
  
  edge_colors <- ifelse(
    pvals < 0.1 & corr_vals > 0, "#ffa500ff",
    ifelse(pvals < 0.1 & corr_vals < 0, "#4575B4", "#ffffff00")
  )
  
  data.frame(
    source = paste0(prefix, "_", rownames(cor_obj$r)[all_idx[, 1]]),
    target = colnames(cor_obj$r)[all_idx[, 2]],
    correlation = corr_vals,
    pval = pvals,
    col = edge_colors,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# --- Combine all ---
chord_all_male <- rbind(
  extract_all_cor(cor_pfas_male, "SMC"),
  extract_all_cor(cor_met_male, "MC"),
  extract_all_cor(cor_lip_male, "LC"),
  extract_all_cor(cor_trans_male, "TC")
)

chord_all_female <- rbind(
  extract_all_cor(cor_pfas_female, "SMC"),
  extract_all_cor(cor_met_female, "MC"),
  extract_all_cor(cor_lip_female, "LC"),
  extract_all_cor(cor_trans_female, "TC")
)

# --- Chord data preparation ---
prepare_chord_data <- function(chord_df) {
  if (nrow(chord_df) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  # ✅ Extract group from renamed source format (e.g., MC_1)
  chord_df$source_group <- sub("_.*", "", chord_df$source)
  chord_df$target_group <- "Histology"
  
  node_groups <- c(
    setNames(chord_df$source_group, chord_df$source),
    setNames(chord_df$target_group, chord_df$target)
  )
  node_groups <- node_groups[!duplicated(names(node_groups))]
  
  # ✅ Updated group color map
  group_color_map <- c(
    SMC = "#D73027",    # Serum Metabolites
    MC = "#A65628",     # Metabolomics
    LC = "#2ca02c",    # Lipidomics
    TC = "#e377c2",     # Transcriptomics
    Histology = "#9467bd"
  )
  
  grid_colors <- setNames(group_color_map[as.character(node_groups)], names(node_groups))
  
  return(list(data = chord_df, grid.col = grid_colors, node_groups = node_groups))
}

# --- Plot function ---
plot_chord_pretty <- function(chord_df, title_text) {
  if (nrow(chord_df) == 0) {
    message("No associations to display.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  prep <- prepare_chord_data(chord_df)
  chord_data <- prep$data
  grid_colors <- prep$grid.col
  
  circos.clear()
  chordDiagram(
    chord_data[, c("source", "target")],
    grid.col = grid_colors,
    col = chord_data$col,
    transparency = 0.3,
    directional = 1,
    annotationTrack = c("grid"),
    preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.1)
  )
  
  circos.trackPlotRegion(
    track.index = 1,
    panel.fun = function(x, y) {
      sector_name <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
      xlim <- get.cell.meta.data("xlim")
      ylim <- get.cell.meta.data("ylim")
      circos.text(
        x = mean(xlim),
        y = ylim[1] + mm_y(0),
        labels = sector_name,
        facing = "clockwise",
        niceFacing = TRUE,
        adj = c(0, 0.5),
        cex = 0.8,
        col = grid_colors[sector_name]
      )
    },
    bg.border = NA
  )
  
  title(main = title_text, cex.main = 1.5)
  
  legend(
    "topleft",
    legend = c("Positive correlation", "Negative correlation"),
    col = c("#ffa500ff", "#4575B4"),
    lty = 1, lwd = 2, cex = 1.1, bty = "n", title = "Edge direction"
  )
  
  legend(
    "bottomleft",
    legend = c("Serum Metabolites", "Metabolomics", "Lipidomics",  "Transcriptomics", "Histology"),
    fill = c("#D73027", "#A65628", "#2ca02c",  "#e377c2", "#9467bd"),
    border = NA,
    cex = 1.1, bty = "n", title = "Node type"
  )
}
```

### Cross-omics correlations (e.g., TC vs LC, TC vs MC, LC vs MC, etc.) ---
```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=10}

# Generic function to compute correlations between two omics layers
cross_omics_correlation <- function(omics1, omics2, prefix1, prefix2) {
  common_ids <- intersect(colnames(omics1), colnames(omics2))
  if (length(common_ids) < 5) return(data.frame()) # not enough overlap
  
  cor_obj <- corr.test(
    t(omics1[, common_ids, drop = FALSE]),
    t(omics2[, common_ids, drop = FALSE]),
    method = "spearman", adjust = "fdr"
  )
  
  all_idx <- which(!is.na(cor_obj$r), arr.ind = TRUE)
  if (length(all_idx) == 0) return(data.frame())
  
  corr_vals <- cor_obj$r[all_idx]
  pvals <- cor_obj$p.adj[all_idx]
  
  edge_colors <- ifelse(
    pvals < 0.1 & corr_vals > 0, "#ffa500ff",
    ifelse(pvals < 0.1 & corr_vals < 0, "#4575B4", "#ffffff00")
  )
  
  data.frame(
    source = paste0(prefix1, "_", rownames(cor_obj$r)[all_idx[, 1]]),
    target = paste0(prefix2, "_", colnames(cor_obj$r)[all_idx[, 2]]),
    correlation = corr_vals,
    pval = pvals,
    col = edge_colors,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
}

# --- Run for male
cross_male_TC_LC <- cross_omics_correlation(trans_male, lip_male, "TC", "LC")
cross_male_TC_MC <- cross_omics_correlation(trans_male, met_male, "TC", "MC")
cross_male_LC_MC <- cross_omics_correlation(lip_male, met_male, "LC", "MC")
cross_male_MC_SMC <- cross_omics_correlation(met_male, pfas_male, "MC", "SMC")

cross_all_male <- rbind(cross_male_TC_LC, cross_male_TC_MC, cross_male_LC_MC, cross_male_MC_SMC)

# --- Run for female
cross_female_TC_LC <- cross_omics_correlation(trans_female, lip_female, "TC", "LC")
cross_female_TC_MC <- cross_omics_correlation(trans_female, met_female, "TC", "MC")
cross_female_LC_MC <- cross_omics_correlation(lip_female, met_female, "LC", "MC")
cross_female_MC_SMC <- cross_omics_correlation(met_female, pfas_female, "MC", "SMC")

cross_all_female <- rbind(cross_female_TC_LC, cross_female_TC_MC, cross_female_LC_MC, cross_female_MC_SMC)

# --- Plot chord diagrams for cross-omics integration ---
plot_chord_pretty(cross_all_male, "Male: Cross-omics Associations")
plot_chord_pretty(cross_all_female, "Female: Cross-omics Associations")
```

```{r}
### Cross-omics correlations with consistent color coding and cleaned node names

plot_chord_crossomics <- function(chord_df, title_text) {
  if (nrow(chord_df) == 0) {
    message("No associations to display.")
    return(NULL)
  }
  
  # --- Remove '_ME' suffix from source and target ---
  chord_df$source <- gsub("_ME", "_", chord_df$source)
  chord_df$target <- gsub("_ME", "_", chord_df$target)
  
  # Extract node groups from source and target
  chord_df$source_group <- sub("_.*", "", chord_df$source)
  chord_df$target_group <- sub("_.*", "", chord_df$target)
  
  node_groups <- c(
    setNames(chord_df$source_group, chord_df$source),
    setNames(chord_df$target_group, chord_df$target)
  )
  node_groups <- node_groups[!duplicated(names(node_groups))]
  
  # Use the same color map
  group_color_map <- c(
    SMC = "#D73027",    # Serum Metabolites
    MC  = "#A65628",    # Metabolomics
    LC  = "#2ca02c",    # Lipidomics
    TC  = "#e377c2"     # Transcriptomics
  )
  
  grid_colors <- setNames(group_color_map[as.character(node_groups)], names(node_groups))
  
  circos.clear()
  chordDiagram(
    chord_df[, c("source", "target")],
    grid.col = grid_colors,
    col = chord_df$col,
    transparency = 0.3,
    directional = 1,
    annotationTrack = c("grid"),
    preAllocateTracks = list(track.height = 0.1)
  )
  
  circos.trackPlotRegion(
    track.index = 1,
    panel.fun = function(x, y) {
      sector_name <- get.cell.meta.data("sector.index")
      xlim <- get.cell.meta.data("xlim")
      ylim <- get.cell.meta.data("ylim")
      circos.text(
        x = mean(xlim),
        y = ylim[1] + mm_y(0),
        labels = sector_name,
        facing = "clockwise",
        niceFacing = TRUE,
        adj = c(0, 0.5),
        cex = 0.8,
        col = grid_colors[sector_name]
      )
    },
    bg.border = NA
  )
  
  title(main = title_text, cex.main = 1.5)
  
  legend(
    "topleft",
    legend = c("Positive correlation", "Negative correlation"),
    col = c("#ffa500ff", "#4575B4"),
    lty = 1, lwd = 2, cex = 1.1, bty = "n", title = "Edge direction"
  )
  
  legend(
    "bottomleft",
    legend = names(group_color_map),
    fill = group_color_map,
    border = NA,
    cex = 1.1, bty = "n", title = "Node type"
  )
}

# --- Final plots with updated names ---
plot_chord_crossomics(cross_all_male, "Men")
plot_chord_crossomics(cross_all_female, "Women")

```





# Mediation Analysis: Lipids/metabolites

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

library(dplyr)
library(gtsummary)

phenotype <- data.frame(readxl::read_excel("/Users/skga/Desktop/Gothenburg_project/Analyisis/Metadata.xlsx"))
rownames(phenotype) <- phenotype$id
phenotype <- phenotype[,-1]


# Rename columns
phenotype <- phenotype %>%
  rename(
    Age = Age_yr,
    BMI = BMI_kgm2,
    Menopause = Menopause_YN,
    Glucose = Glucose_mgdL,
    HbA1c = HbA1c_percent,
    AST = AST_UL,
    ALT = ALT_UL,
    Cholesterol = Cholesterol_mgdL,
    HDL = HDL_mgdL,
    LDL = LDL_mgdL,
    TG = TG_mgdL,
    Steatosis = steatosis_Kleiner,
    Inflammation = inflammation_Kleiner,
    MASH = NASH_Kleiner_YN,
    Fibrosis = fibrosis_Kleiner_04,
    Gender = Gender_M0F1
  )


df <- tibble::rownames_to_column(phenotype, "SampleID")
min_value_GGT_UL <- min(df$GGT_UL, na.rm = TRUE)
df$GGT_UL[is.na(df$GGT_UL)] <- min_value_GGT_UL / 2

df$Steatosis <- ifelse(df$Steatosis == 0, 0, 1)
df$Inflammation <- ifelse(df$Inflammation == 0, 0, 1)
df$Fibrosis <- ifelse(df$Fibrosis == 0, 0, 1)


#transcriptomics_MEs<- MEs_filtered

metabolomics_MEs <- t(metabolomics_MEs)
transcriptomics_MEs <- t(transcriptomics_MEs)
lipidomics_MEs <- t(lipidomics_MEs)

#df$SampleID <- row.names(df)
row.names(df) <- df$SampleID


common_samples <- Reduce(intersect, list(
  colnames(transcriptomics_MEs),
  colnames(metabolomics_MEs),
  colnames(lipidomics_MEs),
  rownames(df)
))

# Subset and transpose for mediation (samples as rows)
tx <- t(transcriptomics_MEs[, common_samples])
met <- t(metabolomics_MEs[, common_samples])
lip <- t(lipidomics_MEs[, common_samples])
pheno <- df[common_samples, ]

pheno$Gender <- ifelse(pheno$Gender == "Male", 0, 1)

colnames(tx) <- paste0("tx_", colnames(tx))
colnames(met) <- paste0("met_", colnames(met))
colnames(lip) <- paste0("lip_", colnames(lip))


run_mediation_analysis <- function(outcome_var, tx, met, lip, pheno) {
  library(mediation)
  results <- list()
  counter <- 1
  
  for (g in colnames(tx)) {
    for (m in c(colnames(met), colnames(lip))) {
      mediator_block <- if (m %in% colnames(met)) met else lip
      
      med_df <- data.frame(
        Gene = tx[, g],
        Mediator = mediator_block[, m],
        Outcome = as.numeric(as.character(pheno[[outcome_var]])),
        Age = pheno$Age,
        Gender = as.factor(pheno$Gender),
        BMI = pheno$BMI
      )
      
      try({
        med.fit <- lm(Mediator ~ Gene + Age + Gender + BMI, data = med_df)
        out.fit <- glm(Outcome ~ Gene + Mediator + Age + Gender + BMI, data = med_df, family = binomial)
        med.out <- mediation::mediate(med.fit, out.fit, treat = "Gene", mediator = "Mediator", boot = TRUE, sims = 1000)
        
        results[[counter]] <- data.frame(
          TranscriptomicME = g,
          MediatorME = m,
          Outcome = outcome_var,
          ACME = med.out$d0,
          ACME_p = med.out$d0.p,
          ADE = med.out$z0,
          ADE_p = med.out$z0.p,
          TotalEffect = med.out$tau.coef,
          TotalEffect_p = med.out$tau.p,
          PropMediated = med.out$n0
        )
        counter <- counter + 1
      }, silent = TRUE)
    }
  }
  
  do.call(rbind, results)
}




# Run
res_steatosis <- run_mediation_analysis("Steatosis", tx, met, lip, pheno)
res_inflam <- run_mediation_analysis("Inflammation", tx, met, lip, pheno)
res_fibro <- run_mediation_analysis("Fibrosis", tx, met, lip, pheno)
all_mediation <- rbind(res_steatosis, res_inflam, res_fibro)

all_mediation$ACME_FDR <- p.adjust(all_mediation$ACME_p, method = "fdr")
all_mediation$ADE_FDR <- p.adjust(all_mediation$ADE_p, method = "fdr")
all_mediation$TotalEffect_FDR <- p.adjust(all_mediation$TotalEffect_p, method = "fdr")


sig_mediated_all <- subset(all_mediation, ACME_FDR < 0.05 & PropMediated > 0)




top_plot <- sig_mediated_all %>%
  dplyr::arrange(ACME_FDR, desc(PropMediated))



```


```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=8}
library(ggplot2)
library(ggalluvial)
library(dplyr)

# Keep top N mediated effects if needed (optional)
top_plot_shankey <- top_plot %>%
  #head(30) %>% # adjust this number if needed
  mutate(
    Direction = ifelse(ACME > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
    MediatorType = ifelse(grepl("^met_", MediatorME), "Metabolite", "Lipid"),
    TranscriptType = "Transcriptomic",
    MediatorLabel = paste0(MediatorME)
  )

# Ensure categorical order is preserved in plot
top_plot_shankey$TranscriptomicME <- factor(top_plot_shankey$TranscriptomicME,
                                            levels = unique(top_plot_shankey$TranscriptomicME))
top_plot_shankey$MediatorLabel <- factor(top_plot_shankey$MediatorLabel,
                                         levels = unique(top_plot_shankey$MediatorLabel))
top_plot_shankey$Outcome <- factor(top_plot_shankey$Outcome,
                                   levels = c("Steatosis", "Inflammation", "Fibrosis"))




# Modify module names for better readability
top_plot_shankey <- top_plot_shankey %>%
  mutate(
    TranscriptomicME = gsub("tx_ME", "TC", TranscriptomicME),
    MediatorLabel = gsub("lip_ME", "LC", MediatorLabel),
    MediatorLabel = gsub("met_ME", "MC", MediatorLabel)
  )


# Step 2: Base plot without labels
base_plot <- ggplot(top_plot_shankey,
       aes(axis1 = TranscriptomicME,
           axis2 = MediatorLabel,
           axis3 = Outcome,
           y = PropMediated)) +
  geom_alluvium(aes(fill = Direction), width = 0.15, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_stratum(width = 0.15, fill = "grey95", color = "black") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Positive" = "lightskyblue", "Negative" = "lightpink")) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c("Transcriptomic Module", "Mediator Module", "MASLD Outcome")) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 12) +
  labs(
    title = "Sankey Plot of Directional Mediation Effects",
    y = "Proportion Mediated",
    x = NULL,
    fill = "Mediation Direction"
  ) +
  theme(
    axis.text.y = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 0),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5)
  )

# Step 3: Extract stratum data for custom label positioning
strata_data <- ggplot_build(base_plot)$data[[2]]

# Step 4: Add label + conditionally rotate MASLD outcome labels
strata_data <- strata_data %>%
  mutate(
    label = stratum,
    angle = ifelse(stratum %in% c("Steatosis", "Inflammation", "Fibrosis"), 90, 0),
    hjust = ifelse(stratum %in% c("Steatosis", "Inflammation", "Fibrosis"), 0.5, 0.5),
    vjust = ifelse(stratum %in% c("Steatosis", "Inflammation", "Fibrosis"), 0.5, 0.5)
  )

# Step 5: Add manually positioned text labels
final_plot <- base_plot +
  geom_text(data = strata_data,
            aes(x = x, y = y, label = label, angle = angle, hjust = hjust, vjust = vjust),
            inherit.aes = FALSE,
            size = 3.5)

# Step 6: Display the plot
final_plot

```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
tx <- t(transcriptomics_MEs[, common_samples])
met <- t(metabolomics_MEs[, common_samples])
lip <- t(lipidomics_MEs[, common_samples])
pheno <- df[common_samples, ]

# Filter for Females
pheno <- pheno %>% filter(Gender == "Female")

# Subset omics data to common samples for females
female_samples <- rownames(pheno)
tx_female <- tx[female_samples, ]
met_female <- met[female_samples, ]
lip_female <- lip[female_samples, ]

pheno$Gender <- 1 # Set gender to 1 for analysis, though now constant

colnames(tx_female) <- paste0("tx_", colnames(tx_female))
colnames(met_female) <- paste0("met_", colnames(met_female))
colnames(lip_female) <- paste0("lip_", colnames(lip_female))

run_mediation_analysis <- function(outcome_var, tx, met, lip, pheno) {
 library(mediation)
 results <- list()
 counter <- 1

 for (g in colnames(tx)) {
for (m in c(colnames(met), colnames(lip))) {
 mediator_block <- if (m %in% colnames(met)) met else lip

 med_df <- data.frame(
Gene = tx[, g],
Mediator = mediator_block[, m],
Outcome = as.numeric(as.character(pheno[[outcome_var]])),
Age = pheno$Age,
BMI = pheno$BMI
 )

 try({
med.fit <- lm(Mediator ~ Gene + Age + BMI, data = med_df)
out.fit <- glm(Outcome ~ Gene + Mediator + Age + BMI, data = med_df, family = binomial)
med.out <- mediation::mediate(med.fit, out.fit, treat = "Gene", mediator = "Mediator", boot = TRUE, sims = 1000)

results[[counter]] <- data.frame(
 TranscriptomicME = g,
 MediatorME = m,
 Outcome = outcome_var,
 ACME = med.out$d0,
 ACME_p = med.out$d0.p,
 ADE = med.out$z0,
 ADE_p = med.out$z0.p,
 TotalEffect = med.out$tau.coef,
 TotalEffect_p = med.out$tau.p,
 PropMediated = med.out$n0
)
counter <- counter + 1
 }, silent = TRUE)
}
 }

 do.call(rbind, results)
}

# Run mediation analysis for females
res_steatosis_female <- run_mediation_analysis("Steatosis", tx_female, met_female, lip_female, pheno)
res_inflam_female <- run_mediation_analysis("Inflammation", tx_female, met_female, lip_female, pheno)
res_fibro_female <- run_mediation_analysis("Fibrosis", tx_female, met_female, lip_female, pheno)
all_mediation_female <- rbind(res_steatosis_female, res_inflam_female, res_fibro_female)

all_mediation_female$ACME_FDR <- p.adjust(all_mediation_female$ACME_p, method = "fdr")
all_mediation_female$ADE_FDR <- p.adjust(all_mediation_female$ADE_p, method = "fdr")
all_mediation_female$TotalEffect_FDR <- p.adjust(all_mediation_female$TotalEffect_p, method = "fdr")

```

```{r, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, fig.align='center', fig.height=8}
library(igraph)
library(ggraph)
library(tidygraph)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

make_mediation_network <- function(data, outcome_filter, edge_color) {
  df <- data %>%
    filter(Outcome == outcome_filter) %>%
    mutate(
      Direction = ifelse(ACME > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
      MediatorType = ifelse(grepl("^met_", MediatorME), "Metabolite", "Lipid")
    )
  
  edges1 <- df %>%
    transmute(from = TranscriptomicME,
              to = MediatorME,
              outcome = Outcome,
              PropMediated = PropMediated,
              Direction = Direction)
  
  edges2 <- df %>%
    transmute(from = MediatorME,
              to = Outcome,
              outcome = Outcome,
              PropMediated = PropMediated,
              Direction = Direction)
  
  edges_all <- bind_rows(edges1, edges2)
  
  # Define node types
  nodes <- unique(c(edges_all$from, edges_all$to))
  node_type <- sapply(nodes, function(x) {
    if (x %in% df$TranscriptomicME) "Transcriptomic"
    else if (x %in% df$MediatorME & grepl("^met_", x)) "Metabolite"
    else if (x %in% df$MediatorME & grepl("^lip_", x)) "Lipid"
    else if (x == outcome_filter) "Outcome"
    else "Other"
  })
  
  g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges_all, vertices = data.frame(name = nodes, type = node_type))
  
  p <- ggraph(as_tbl_graph(g), layout = "fr") +
    geom_edge_link(aes(width = PropMediated,
                       linetype = Direction),
                   color = edge_color,
                   arrow = arrow(length = unit(3, "mm")),
                   end_cap = circle(3, "mm"),
                   alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_node_point(aes(color = type), size = 6) +
    geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE, size = 3) +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      Transcriptomic = "#377eb8",
      Metabolite = "#4daf4a",
      Lipid = "#ff7f00",
      Outcome = edge_color
    )) +
    scale_edge_width(range = c(0.5, 2.5)) +
    scale_edge_linetype_manual(values = c("Positive" = "solid", "Negative" = "dashed")) +
    theme_void() +
    labs(title = paste0("Mediation Network: ", outcome_filter),
         color = "Node Type",
         linetype = "Direction of Mediation")
  
  return(p)
}
# Make sure `top_50` is available and pre-filtered from earlier
p_steatosis <- make_mediation_network(top_plot, "Steatosis", "#1f78b4")
p_inflammation <- make_mediation_network(top_plot, "Inflammation", "#e31a1c")
p_fibrosis <- make_mediation_network(top_plot, "Fibrosis", "#33a02c")
p_steatosis
p_inflammation
p_fibrosis
```
